STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_1_TEXT_1.label: Morty, stop pacing and hand me that screwdriver.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_2_TEXT_1.label: Here you go. What are you making, Rick?

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_2_TEXT_2.label: I'm building a device, Morty. I call it the MortyPad!

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_2_TEXT_3.label: The MortyPad, is that where this funky music is coming from?

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_2_TEXT_4.label: Yeah, Morty. But, as usual, you've missed the real point here.*The MortyPad also collects stats on all the Mortys we meet.*There are dimensions everywhere, Morty. All inhabited by other Mortys.*Although I'm getting some crazy readings. It seems like Mortys are being separated from their Ricks.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_2_TEXT_6.label: Yeah. I mean, us Ricks need to get a break from you Mortys every once in a while, but these separation numbers are through the roof.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_4_TEXT_1.label: Another Rick! He’s here to take the MortyPad, Morty!

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_5_TEXT_1.label: MortyPad? What? No, I’m here to capture that Morty!

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_5_TEXT_2.label: Oh it's fine, Morty. He doesn’t want the MortyPad. He just wants you.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_5_TEXT_3.label: Me? Why does he want me?

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_5_TEXT_4.label: Just do what he says, Morty. I don't want a Ricktastrophe on our hands.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_6_TEXT_1.label: So pure, so beautiful. I want!

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_6_TEXT_3.label: Such delicate skin! Could he be... the Legendary Morty?

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_7_TEXT_1.label: Fine, fine. Rick steps in to save the day again.*Hey, buddy. This is MY Morty, so why don’t you just crawl back to the dimension you came from?

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_7_TEXT_2.label: YOUR Morty?! You mean you already caught him? I’m too late.*That leaves us with one option: we must battle our Mortys!

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_7_TEXT_3.label: Rick, that doesn't sound like such a good idea.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_7_TEXT_4.label: Hang on, Morty. This could be a good opportunity to test the MortyPad, gather some data.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_7_TEXT_5.label: I don’t think I should, Rick. It doesn’t sound safe.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_7_TEXT_6.label: It’s ok, Morty. I've got a friend who can talk us through it. You’ll be fine.*Let's battle!

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_8_TEXT_1.label: Defeated? Me? This can't be!*I must return to my dimension to train my Morty!

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_9_TEXT_1.label: Wow, did you feel that, Morty? What a rush!

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_9_TEXT_2.label: I just feel pain, Rick. A lot of pain.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_9_TEXT_3.label: He almost had us, Morty! He came from behind and almost had us.*We need to train you up, Morty. Situations like this are why I built the MortyPad.*We need to train you, gather data, make you stronger!

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_9_TEXT_4.label: I don't think I should battle again, Rick.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_9_TEXT_5.label: You have to, Morty. How else am I going to get my research if you don't?*That guy could come back with an army of Mortys!*If we don't gather data for the MortyPad, we might not be able to beat him next time!*You have to do this, Morty. You have to battle for science! Only you can save us, Morty.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_9_TEXT_6.label: Is this really the only way, Rick? I feel like there has to be another way.

STORY_GARAGE_INTRO_PHASE_9_TEXT_7.label: There isn't, Morty. I don't like it either, but it's the only way.*First, we need to find out what that Rick is up to, Morty.*Quick, let's follow him through the portal!

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_INTRO_PHASE_1_TEX.label: Where are we, Rick? This isn't the garage.
Oh no, Morty. I know this place. This is the Citadel of Ricks!*We're in the Council Chambers, Morty. {0} set us up!*These people don’t play ball. Let's get out of here before we're seen.

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_INTRO_PHASE_2_TEX.label: Well, well, well! We meet again, Rick.*Seize his portal gun!

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_INTRO_PHASE_4_TEX.label: Rick, it has come to our attention that you engaged in a Morty battle while in possession of an unlicensed portal gun.
What I do with my Morty and my portal gun is none of your business!

Oh, but it is, Rick!*Morty battles have become a craze of late. They must be regulated by a well-respected council!*And we have decided that only the most well-respected Morty trainers can be trusted with a portal gun.
Do I look like a second-rate Rick to you? I know how to train my Morty!

We need proof, Rick, to make sure you play by the rules for once.*You'll need to earn some badges by defeating other Ricks in battle. For each Rick you defeat, you'll earn a badge.*Once you have enough badges, you may battle us to prove you're responsible enough to be trusted with your portal gun!
I don’t want to take these guys on, Rick. They look serious.
It looks like we're going to have to do this, Morty.*These guys are ruthless when it comes to rules and we need my portal gun to make it back home.
Rick, when you leave these chambers, head to the lower section of the Citadel.*There you will find a portal that will take you to an authorized Morty battling dimension.
This could be good, Morty.*It'll give us a chance to train you, see what you can do.*With the MortyPad, we'll be unstoppable!
Now leave, Rick. Come back after you've earned some badges.

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_INTRO_PHASE_5_TEX.label: If you've got gas, Morty, now's a great time to let it out...

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_BATTLE_FAIL.label: Haha, you're not in my league yet, Rick!*Come back when you have at least {0} badges.

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_ENDING_PHASE_1_TE.label: Welcome to my party, Rick. Do you like what I've done with the place?

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_ENDING_PHASE_2_TE.label: Mysterious Rick! What the hell's going on here?
Rick, he’s gone power crazy! He's become too strong for us to handle!*He's taken your Portal Gun, you need to save us!
Leave us alone, Rick! I have this under control. No trainer is better than me!

Silence! Let's cut to the cake, Rick: you have what I want and it's not this stupid Portal Gun.*Give me that Morty of yours. He's so pure... the purest of them all!*Hand him over or you'll never see your Portal Gun again.
What do you think, Morty? Fancy starting a new life with this jerk?
What's wrong with this guy, Rick? He makes me sick.*He needs to be taught a lesson. Let me at him!
That's my Morty!*Hey, Mysterious Rick! I'm bringing some punch to your party and it's got a real kick to it.*Let's do this!

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_ENDING_PHASE_3_TE.label: Noooo, my stupid Mortys! They've let their trainer down! Their glorious trainer!
I guess you're not the best trainer in the Multiverse then, huh?
Guards, quick! Restrain Mysterious Rick while he's weak!
Rick, you have saved us. We are forever in your debt. How can we ever repay you?
Hold it! I had this all under control, I... I was just waiting for the right time to step in.
Waiting for the right time to grow a pair! Wait until everyone hears about this little incident. You'll be a laughing stock!
Rick! You wouldn't dare. What happens in the Council Chambers stays in the Council Chambers.
Whatever. I think we can all agree that I'm the best trainer now. Hand over that sash or this thing goes viral.
A sash? Hah, truly great trainers have a signature look. I mean, just look at me...*You just look like any other generic Rick, Rick.
You're right— I think that cape of yours will fix that. I guess you won't be needing it anymore.

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_ENDING_PHASE_4_TE.label: We did it, Morty. We reached the top! I knew you had it in you, Morty. I never doubted you!
Yeah, Rick! And we have the Portal Gun! We can finally go home!
Home? Why would we go home? We're famous, Morty. Revered across the Multiverse!*Think of the fame, the attention, the girls! Think of the girls, Morty!

I don't know, Rick. That's not why we started this.*Although… I am feeling pretty awesome right now with all these abilities.*I guess we could carry on. After all, there are lots more wild Mortys out there who need our help, right?

That's the spirit, Morty. Let's get back out there and catch us some more Mortys!*Rick and Morty adventuring for ever and ever, never not battling!*That's my catchphrase, Morty! I say that all the time!

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_POST_CRED_PHASE_1.label: I hope you're enjoying the sash, Rick.*But you aren't truly the best until you've caught every wild Morty!*Get back out there and keep training.

STORY_COUNCIL_CHAMBERS_POST_CRED_PHASE_2.label: So, you have caught every known Morty the Multiverse has to offer?*What amazing use of your time, Rick.*I guess this makes you the Rickest Rick there ever was.*Just remember, the Council is always discovering new Mortys for you to collect. A scientist's work is never done.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_1_TEXT_1.label: Morty, this must be that {0}’s dimension.*We should look around for him.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_TEXT_1.label: Hey, look, Rick. There's something on the ground.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_2_TEXT_2.label: You're right, Morty. Let's go pick it up.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_TEXT_1.label: Look, another Morty!*He looks like a scruffier version of me, Rick.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_TEXT_2.label: Yeah, Morty, he must have been separated from his Rick. He's become lost and slightly feral.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_TEXT_3.label: Oh, Rick, that's horrible! We have to help him.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_3_TEXT_4.label: If I can hack that chip we found and attach it to him, he'll think he belongs to us.*It's going to be tricky though— wild Mortys are easily spooked.*We can chase him to wear him out, then catch him as he takes a breath. Let's give it a go.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_4_TEXT_2.label: We did, Morty. He thinks I’m his Rick!*The MortyPad shows all his vital signs are good, Morty. With a little persuasion he can help us in battle.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_4_TEXT_3.label: Rick! We're supposed to be helping him, not making him battle!

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_4_TEXT_4.label: We are, Morty! We are! But many hands make light work. With his help, the weight will be off your shoulders.*It also goes without saying that you're the leader of this pack.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_4_TEXT_5.label: Wow, I guess it would.*When you put it like that, Rick, I guess we could do with the extra help…

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_4_TEXT_6.label: That's the spirit, Morty. Now, let's get back to finding {0}.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_5_TEXT_1.label: OK, Morty, I set up the MortyPad to track all of the Mortys we've encountered.*I can also use items and check the current Mortys in our party.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_5_TEXT_2.label: That's great, Rick, but I don’t feel so good.*These battles are draining.

WORLD_DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_PHASE_5_TEXT_3.label: That serum we just got from our last battle looks like it has healing powers, Morty.*Let's try it out now to see if it makes you feel better.

SignPostTutorialItem.dialogue: Pick up an item by standing next to it and pressing 'A'.

SignPostTutorialMorty.dialogue: Chase wild Mortys to wear them out. While they're catching their breath, press ‘A’ to initiate a battle.

SignPostTutorialTrainer.dialogue: Signposts give helpful tips. Read them to become the best trainer around!

SignPost1.dialogue: Each dimension has a boss Rick, the toughest trainer of that dimension. Level up your Mortys against easy trainers before taking him on.

SignPost2.dialogue: Visit the Healing Center whenever you return to the Citadel. Your Mortys will be in tip-top condition before taking on the next dimension.

SignPost3.dialogue: You can buy items from Salesman Rick's right from your MortyPad. Spend those Schmeckles wisely.

SignPost4.dialogue: If you catch two Mortys of the same type, you can combine them at Morty Day Care. You'll be surprised at the results.

SignPost5.dialogue: If you catch two Mortys of the same type, you can combine them at Morty Day Care. You'll be surprised at the results.

SignPost6.dialogue: Share your crafting recipes on Twitter. You may help out another Rick! #PocketMortys

SignPost7.dialogue: Council Members giving you a hard time? Use Mega Seeds to increase your Mortys' stats.

SignPost8.dialogue: Keep an eye on the AP (Attack Points) of your Mortys' attacks. If it reaches zero, he won't be able to use that attack.

SignPost9.dialogue: Stock up on items from Salesman Rick's in the Citadel or from your MortyPad. It could make the difference between winning and losing.

SignPost10.dialogue: Do your Mortys lack the punch you need? Visit Morty Day Care in the Citadel and try combining Mortys of the same type to make them stronger.

SignPost11.dialogue: Be sure to look around each dimension you visit. You might just find an item you need-- or a super rare Morty!

SignPost12.dialogue: Always heal your Mortys before entering a new dimension. The Healing Center is free to use; don't risk a black out!

SignPost13.dialogue: There is more to a Morty than just his looks. Check out the Morty Deck for detailed stats and trivia.

SignPost14.dialogue: Please don't walk on the grass!

SignPost15.dialogue: Has anyone lost their Jerry? He is waiting for you at the Lost and Found.

SignPost16.dialogue: A crafty trainer once broke into Morty Day Care and stole all the Mortys. They were never found.

SignPost17.dialogue: For Sale: Morty shoes, never worn.

SignPost18.dialogue: Try combining a Battery and Fleeb at a craft bench!

SignPost19.dialogue: Search the Citadel for Quest givers; they can be generous with rewards! Check for active Quests from your MortyPad.

SignPost20.dialogue: If you are reading this, it means we are already too late.

SignPost21.dialogue: Come home. We love you and we forgive you.

SignPost22.dialogue: There are many Mortys without a Rick and there and many Ricks without a Morty.

SignPost24.dialogue: Don’t run before you can walk; pace yourself.

SignPost25.dialogue: Level up all your Mortys. Leave no Morty behind if you want to get ahead.

SignPost26.dialogue: A well maintained Morty is a useful Morty.

SignPost27.dialogue: There’s no going back now, Rick. You always knew there was never any chance of returning anyway.

SignPost28.dialogue: Your Mortys need you; don’t forget to heal them.

SignPost29.dialogue: If you’re gonna polish your Morty, watch out for blisters.

SignPost30.dialogue: Have you ever heard of quantum reincarnation?

SignPost31.dialogue: Remember to use items while battling!

SignPost32.dialogue: If they only knew, Rick. If they only knew...

SignPost33.dialogue: We always hurt the ones we love, no matter which dimension they are from.

SignPost34.dialogue: Do not try to put Mortys in your pocket.

SignPost35.dialogue: Youthful innocence is lost early in battle, where the hearts of Mortys grow hard.

SignPost36.dialogue: It's only a game; don’t feel sorry for your Mortys.

SignPost37.dialogue: Remember to combine your Mortys! You can always catch more.

SignPost38.dialogue: When fate comes a-knockin’, you’ve gotta get out of the kitchen and into your busy shoes if you want to get ahead.

SignPost40.dialogue: You can’t choose your family, but you CAN choose which interdimensional versions of your grandson you want to follow you around.

SignPost41.dialogue: Lost cat. Answers to the name ‘Mr Flullyploops’.

SignPost42.dialogue: Don’t be a Jerry: keep your Mortys safe!

SignPost43.dialogue: There is a Morty that glows as bright as the sun, his golden arm reaching out to all that believe.

SignPost44.dialogue: “I thought I saw a new type of Morty, but I only caught a glimpse of his shadow. I’ll keep looking.” -Old Trainer Rick.

SignPost45.dialogue: “I had a dream that a ghostly Morty visited me in my sleep. I think I’ll keep the light on tonight.” -Old Trainer Rick.

SignPost46.dialogue: “Met a Rick today who was crazier than me. His obsession with collecting Mortys gave me a bad feeling...” -Old Trainer Rick.

MortyHobo.name: Hobo Morty
MortyHobo.description: This Morty lurks around inner city parks, waiting to touch unsupervised dogs without the owner's consent.

MortyOld.name: Old Morty
MortyOld.description: This Morty remembers when this all used to be fields and he could fly his kite freely without fear of it getting stuck in a tree.

MortyGeriatric.name: Geriatric Morty
MortyGeriatric.description: This Morty sits alone in his small room, looking through old photo albums at faces he can’t quite remember. He waits for the comfort that only the grave can bring.

MortyAncient.name: Ancient Morty
MortyAncient.description: This Morty chose poorly. Dried up and dead to the world, only hatred, cruel fate and years of modern food preservatives keep his wicked heart beating.

MortyRabbit.name: Rabbit Morty
MortyRabbit.description: This Morty was bitten by a radioactive bunny and now turns into a rabbit every time a carrot is near. Unfortunately, he's from a dimension where Humans evolved from carrots.

MortyEvilRabbit.name: Evil Rabbit Morty
MortyEvilRabbit.description: This Morty is an evil cosplayer from a dimension where Halloween is 340 days long. His rabbit costume used to be pink and cute but has since faded to a dull gray from overuse.

MortyNoEye.name: No Eye Morty
MortyNoEye.description: This Morty refuses to talk about his impairment, but some say he lost his eyes when his Rick tried to swap them for his own.

MortyOneEye.name: One Eye Morty
MortyOneEye.description: This Morty has never felt accepted among the other Mortys. He hopes that they will one day see things the way he does.

MortyThreeEye.name: Three Eye Morty
MortyThreeEye.description: This Morty has seen everything... but has yet to feel the warmth of a loving touch.

MortyTestX1.name: Test X1 Morty
MortyTestX1.description: This Morty was the first result in a series of experiments performed by a guilt-ridden Rick who spent his dying days trying to bring back his lost grandson.

MortyTestX46.name: Test X46 Morty
MortyTestX46.description: This Morty was the second successful result in a series of experiments that led to the downfall and financial ruin of his creator. This Morty can only feel pain and hunger.

MortyTestX72.name: Test X72 Morty
MortyTestX72.description: This Morty is the result of a transdimensional pharmaceutical conglomerate’s further experimentation on a patented genome acquired through a hostile takeover.

MortySelfDefence.name: Self-Defense Morty
MortySelfDefence.description: This Morty used to get beaten up every day on his way to school. He decided to take self-defense classes to boost his confidence and physical strength.

MortyKarate.name: Karate Morty
MortyKarate.description: This Morty is a dedicated practitioner of karate, spending 12 hours a day working on his forms, sparring, and strength training. This Morty loves karate more than life.

MortyNoMercy.name: No Mercy Morty
MortyNoMercy.description: This Morty has been corrupted by the power he feels in his arms and legs. If you do not follow the way of the fist, he will show you no mercy. There is no fear in his Dojo or his heart.

MortyMustache.name: Mustache Morty
MortyMustache.description: This Morty will take any opportunity to display his fine facial hair. It has won him several trophies.

MortyBeard.name: Beard Morty
MortyBeard.description: This Morty works in a very trendy part of town. On Fridays, he enjoys a nice burrito.

MortyHipster.name: Hipster Morty
MortyHipster.description: This Morty doesn't care what you think of him. He already knows he is cool.

MortyAdSpace.name: Ad Space Morty
MortyAdSpace.description: This Morty is working for free for his father, Jerry. He hopes to never see another apple in his life.

MortyJerrysGame.name: Jerry's Game Morty
MortyJerrysGame.description: This Morty is not ashamed to promote other Rick and Morty games. Y'know, like Jerry's Game. You should download Jerry's Game, by the way.

MortyPocketMortys.name: Pocket Mortys Morty
MortyPocketMortys.description: This Morty feels that a bit of self-promotion could go a long way. He wants to share his love of this game with his friends. You should do the same. Like, right now.

MortyBlueShirt.name: Blue Shirt Morty
MortyBlueShirt.description: This Morty does not want to be defined by wearing the same yellow shirt every day, as other Mortys do. He opted for blue, the color of the summer sky and the distant seas.
MortyBlueShirt.characteristic: Likes shirts and the color blue

MortyRedShirt.name: Red Shirt Morty
MortyRedShirt.description: This Morty finds the color red to be powerful, just like the blood that runs through the veins of all Mortys who follow the "True Way of the Heart" on their path to bliss.

MortyOrangeShirt.name: Orange Shirt Morty
MortyOrangeShirt.description: This Morty's shirt makes him look like a carrot to any rabbits that might be watching from nearby forests. Y'know, like rabbits do.

MortyGreenShirt.name: Green Shirt Morty
MortyGreenShirt.description: This Morty wears a shirt of the purest green that ever was seen in many a year 'round these parts. Behold its glory!

MortyPurpleShirt.name: Purple Shirt Morty
MortyPurpleShirt.description: This Morty wears a purple shirt that he was given while attending a seminar on "power dressing" a few months before the release of this game.

MortyRainbowShirt.name: Rainbow Shirt Morty
MortyRainbowShirt.description: This Morty is the "1 of 2" where neither friends nor loving family may go, his eyes watching a thousand suns and a thousand moons rise and fall together a thousand times.

MortyExoAlpha.name: Exo-Alpha Morty
MortyExoAlpha.description: This mutated Morty is a nobody in his dimension. He lives in the sewers and has tea parties with rats.

MortyExoOmega.name: Exo-Omega Morty
MortyExoOmega.description: This mutated Morty has earned the respect of his peers and is learning to live a normal life.

MortyExoPrime.name: Exo-Prime Morty
MortyExoPrime.description: This mutated Morty is believed to be a horrible tyrant in his dimension. What he lacks in good looks, he makes up in brute strengh.

MortySpoon.name: Spoon Morty
MortySpoon.description: This Morty is holding a spoon.

MortyFork.name: Fork Morty
MortyFork.description: This Morty is holding a fork.

MortySpork.name: Spork Morty
MortySpork.description: This Morty is holding a spork, a combination of a spoon and a fork.

MortyPeace.name: Peace Morty
MortyPeace.description: This Morty hopes to spread love throughout the world. He buys all of his clothes from thrift shops.

MortyHippie.name: Hippie Morty
MortyHippie.description: This Morty makes his own tie-dyed T-shirts and sells them at the local park.

MortyOffTheGrid.name: Off The Grid Morty
MortyOffTheGrid.description: This Morty spends most of his time tied to a tree. He believes the leaves will cleanse the mistakes of his past.

MortyHead1.name: Big Head Morty
MortyHead1.description: This Morty was not given a great start in life. He hopes to one day be a great singer.
MortyHead1.characteristic: Has no body, Just a head

MortyHead2.name: Giant Head Morty
MortyHead2.description: This Morty has lost all sense of smell and feels no pain. His medical condition is not recognised amongst Ricks.
MortyHead2.characteristic: Just a big ol' floating head

MortyHead3.name: Colossal Head Morty
MortyHead3.description: This Morty regrets playing in toxic waste. His Rick has since disowned him and doesn’t even write him letters anymore.

MortySpooky.name: Spooky Morty
MortySpooky.description: This Morty hides in the cupboards of empty rooms and cuts holes in the family bed sheets. He is cold to the touch and can never return home again.

MortyGhostly.name: Ghostly Morty
MortyGhostly.description: This Morty floats over freshly dug graves. He can be seen in south-facing mirrors during the month of October if the moon is full.

MortyPhantom.name: Phantom Morty
MortyPhantom.description: This Morty will visit you at 2:00am if you leave the game running in front of a mirror in an otherwise empty room and knock on the door 3 times before going to sleep.

MortyDouble.name: Double Morty
MortyDouble.description: This Morty made the mistake of holding a penny while standing too close to the bio-magnetic field of the Morty Multiplication Generator that his Rick created.

MortyTriple.name: Triple Morty
MortyTriple.description: This Morty made the mistake of looking into a mirror while touching the supercooled outer casing of the Morty Multiplication Generator that his Rick created.

MortyMulti.name: Multi Morty
MortyMulti.description: This Morty was caught in the shockwave caused by Double and Triple Morty's Multiplication Generator accidents. He's forever stuck in a 5th-dimensional Morty Multiplication feedback loop.

MortyGreaser.name: Greaser Morty
MortyGreaser.description: This Morty was the leader of the pack, rebelling against whatever you've got. He lost everything in a grease fire and had to sell his bike to keep himself in leathers.

MortyBiker.name: Biker Morty
MortyBiker.description: This Morty was born to be wild, a son of the open road, a life of hard living and hard women with his back to the wind and grit in his teeth, forever riding into the desert sun.

MortyStrayCat.name: Stray Cat Morty
MortyStrayCat.description: This Morty believes his Rick is trapped inside the mind of a cat. (His Rick is actually winning an inter-dimensional game of hide and seek.)

MortyTwoCat.name: Two Cat Morty
MortyTwoCat.description: This Morty has adopted two cats. He is unaware that they are actually alien parasites trying to control his mind.
MortyTwoCat.characteristic: Can hold two cats at a time

MortyCrazyCat.name: Crazy Cat Morty
MortyCrazyCat.description: This Morty has found friendship in his feline companions. He now struggles to socialize with humans.

MortyBuff.name: Buff Morty
MortyBuff.description: This Morty doesn't know when enough is enough. He plays rough and won't take no for an answer.

MortyWrestler.name: Wrestler Morty
MortyWrestler.description: This Morty can cut a promo like the best of them, but was forced to retire after a botched suplex from the top rope broke his neck.

MortyVainy.name: Veiny Morty
MortyVainy.description: This Morty asked his Rick for help in his biology class. He's regretted it ever since.

MortyNoSkin.name: No Skin Morty
MortyNoSkin.description: This Morty asked his Rick to create a powerful spot removal cream for his acne. He's regretted it ever since.

MortySkeleton.name: Skeleton Morty
MortySkeleton.description: This Morty asked his Rick to help him with his Halloween costume. He's regretted it ever since.

MortyMagic.name: Magic Morty
MortyMagic.description: This Morty is deceitful. He lied on his exam paper and said he finished his vegetables when he actually did not.

MortyMystic.name: Mystic Morty
MortyMystic.description: This Morty claims he can read minds. He says that he uncovered his Rick's dark secrets and turned him in to the Council of Ricks.

MortyWizard.name: Wizard Morty
MortyWizard.description: This Morty enjoys role playing. He uses it to escape from the real world, imagining himself as a powerful wizard who rules entire kingdoms.

MortyTelepathic.name: Telepathic Morty
MortyTelepathic.description: This Morty woke up with a bad headache and a scar on his head. He is convinced that the first thing he saw was Rick running out of his room.

MortyTelekinetic.name: Telekinetic Morty
MortyTelekinetic.description: This Morty was expelled from school when he accidentally crushed his teacher after concentrating on a math problem too hard.

MortyPsychokinetic.name: Psychokinetic Morty
MortyPsychokinetic.description: This Morty has been seen moving whole planets with his mind. He can also make a cheese sandwich without touching the bread.

MortySwimmer.name: Swimmer Morty
MortySwimmer.description: This Morty feels more at home in the water. He can hold his breath underwater for 3 minutes and 37 seconds.

MortyMermaid.name: Mermaid Morty
MortyMermaid.description: This Morty is sometimes thought to be a myth. He sits on rocks and lures fishermen to their doom.

MortyReverseMermaid.name: Reverse Mermaid Morty
MortyReverseMermaid.description: This Morty is an experiment gone wrong. His Rick was driven mad by the allure of the mythical Mermaid Morty and tried to make one of his own.

MortyBusiness.name: Business Morty
MortyBusiness.description: This Morty is never late for a meeting but has never made it home for any of his son's birthday parties. He's hoping for a promotion.

MortyGaseous.name: Gaseous Morty
MortyGaseous.description: This Morty is from a dimension where it's possible to have really, REALLY bad gas.

MortySausage.name: Sausage Morty
MortySausage.description: This Morty fell into a meat processing machine during a field trip to the sausage factory. He hasn't felt the same since then.

MortyShadow.name: Shadow Morty
MortyShadow.description: This Morty has lost his true form. He wanders around aimlessly in search of himself, unaware that his body was buried many years ago.

MortyAqua.name: Aqua Morty
MortyAqua.description: This Morty comes from a family of fish people. He is a vegan but enjoys chicken on Fridays.

MortyCyclops.name: Cyclops Morty
MortyCyclops.description: This Morty was extradited from his home world after he caused a nuclear silo to explode.

MortyMini.name: Mini Morty
MortyMini.description: This Morty comes from a tiny world created by another Rick. His tiny world was destroyed when that Rick mistook it for a pizza slice. This Morty wants vengeance for the loss of his people.

MortyCowboy.name: Cowboy Morty
MortyCowboy.description: This Morty is from a dimension where a series of very unlikely geopolitical events, coupled with an incredibly popular dance craze, caused everyone to dress like cowboys.

MortyRobot.name: Robot Morty
MortyRobot.description: This Morty claims he is a real boy. It is unknown if his software has malfunctioned or if he really does contain the mind of an actual, biological Morty.

MortyHammerhead.name: Hammerhead Morty
MortyHammerhead.description: This Morty is always there to help. Designed by an award-winning Rick, he was the first in a long line of work bench Mortys.

MortyGuard.name: Guard Morty
MortyGuard.description: This Morty lives a life of strict rules and 5:00am wake-up calls. He dreams of one day leaving this life behind and living in the country with a cow named Daisy.

MortyCronenberg.name: Cronenberg Morty
MortyCronenberg.description: This Morty is from that episode of Rick and Morty where everyone don gets straight Cronenberged up, broh.

MortyMascot.name: Mascot Morty
MortyMascot.description: This Morty can often be seen hyping up the crowd.

MortyEgg.name: Egg Morty
MortyEgg.description: This egg appears to contain a life force.

MortyTheOneTrue.name: The One True Morty
MortyTheOneTrue.description: This Morty is believed, by some, to be the One True Morty.

MortyVNeck.name: V Neck Morty
MortyVNeck.description: This Morty likes to wear low-cut tops. He feels that his v-neck gives him an air of superiority over other Mortys.

MortyVestTop.name: Tank Top Morty
MortyVestTop.description: This Morty works out once a week and likes to show off. He has yet to discover deodorant.

MortyMullet.name: Mullet Morty
MortyMullet.description: This Morty was the first in his dimension to grow a mullet. He was quickly banished to another dimension and told not to return.

MortyChops.name: Chops Morty
MortyChops.description: This Morty is a fan of 80's cop dramas. He hopes to one day find a dimension where crime doesn't pay.

MortyAfro.name: Afro Morty
MortyAfro.description: This Morty spends most of his day tending to his hair. He is fully aware that it's the only thing he has going for him.

MortyTired.name: Tired Morty
MortyTired.description: This Morty has missed a lot of school thanks to his Rick's crazy adventures. He is now looking at a C- in Math.

MortySleepy.name: Sleepy Morty
MortySleepy.description: This Morty is lucky to get even two hours of sleep at night. He suffers from night terrors that developed after he saw his own Rick get turned inside out.

MortyAsleep.name: Asleep Morty
MortyAsleep.description: This Morty is under a witch's spell-- one that can only be broken by a kiss from a handsome prince.

MortyHot.name: Hot Morty
MortyHot.description: This Morty is always too warm. He likes strawberry ice cream and a cool summer breeze.

MortyFlaming.name: Flaming Morty
MortyFlaming.description: This Morty was exposed to a large dose of cosmic radiation after his Rick abandoned him in deep space.

MortyCold.name: Cold Morty
MortyCold.description: This Morty is always too cold. He likes warm cups of cocoa and appreciates a comforter with a tog rating of at least 13.5.

MortyFrozen.name: Frozen Morty
MortyFrozen.description: This Morty had a terrible accident in a cryogenics lab while trying to save his Rick from a life-threatening disease.

MortyFlu.name: Flu Morty
MortyFlu.description: This Morty is from a dimension where they haven't invented vaccines. This Morty is meant to return home with a cure for the common cold.

MortyMutantFlu.name: Mutant Flu Morty
MortyMutantFlu.description: This Morty became terribly ill after Jerry tried to make dinner for him. Jerry used one of Rick's inventions to teleport him away so no one would find out.

MortyDiamondEyes.name: Diamond Eyes Morty
MortyDiamondEyes.description: This Morty tried having his eyes "shined" to allow him to see in the dark. It didn't work, so his Rick just replaced his eyes with diamonds.

MortyCacoon.name: Cocoon Morty
MortyCacoon.description: This Morty is covered in a hard, silk shell. When he emerges, he hopes to be a beautiful butterfly.

MortyButterfly.name: Butterfly Morty
MortyButterfly.description: This Morty failed to become a beautiful butterfly. In fact, he has lost most of his motor skills and can no longer communicate.

MortyPunk.name: Punk Morty
MortyPunk.description: This Morty has had enough of society's rules and will no longer take the weight of The Man pushing down on him.

MortyBigTongue.name: Big Tongue Morty
MortyBigTongue.description: This Morty never fully recovered from the nuclear waste his Rick tried to feed him. His tongue will make your skin tingle if it touches you.

MortyPizza.name: Pizza Morty
MortyPizza.description: This Morty is from a dimension where all life is comprised of living slices of pizza.

MortyMushroomPizza.name: Mushroom Pizza Morty
MortyMushroomPizza.description: This Morty is from a dimension where all life is comprised of living slices of pizza. Mushrooms are the latest fashion trend.

MortyPepperoniPizza.name: Pepperoni Pizza Morty
MortyPepperoniPizza.description: This Morty is from a dimension where all life is comprised of living slices of pizza. He has recently contracted a nasty case of pepperoni after sharing an unprotected oven.

MortyUnicornChaser.name: Unicorn Chaser Morty
MortyUnicornChaser.description: This Morty believes in unicorns and will one day find a unicorn to call his own. Only then will his nightmares stop.

MortyUnicorn.name: Unicorn Morty
MortyUnicorn.description: This Morty is a beautiful and majestic unicorn and would prefer to be known by his unicorn name, ‘Stardust Harmony’.

MortySuperUnicorn.name: Super Unicorn Morty
MortySuperUnicorn.description: This Morty took the full force of a rainbow laser blast to the heart from a Rick who was jealous of his beauty. Healed by the Unicorns of Crystal Forest, he now posseses their powers.

MortyMoon.name: Moon Morty
MortyMoon.description: This Morty worships the Moon and is planning a fantastical expedition to find the hidden gallery-tomb and the portrait it contains that will confirm his beliefs. His Rick has refused to help.

MortySun.name: Sun Morty
MortySun.description: This Morty has a small role as the Sun in a local amateur drama production. It would mean the world to him if his Rick could attend on opening night. His Rick is planning to stay at home.

MortyBlackhole.name: Black Hole Morty
MortyBlackhole.description: This Morty is full of wonders that are waiting just beyond his event horizon to be exposed from the darkness that hides them...

MortyMorticia.name: Morticia
MortyMorticia.description: This Morty is from a dimension where her mother’s womb was 32.54F degrees warmer during the early stages of gastrulation. The moon was also 384,900km away. That matters, folks.

MortySingleSnoozle.name: Single Snoozle Morty
MortySingleSnoozle.description: This Morty is from a dimension where Venus never formed, making Earth the second planet from the sun.

MortyDoubleSnoozle.name: Double Snoozle Morty
MortyDoubleSnoozle.description: This Morty is from a dimension where the early planetoid Theia crashed into Venus instead of what would of later became Earth.

MortyTripleSnoozle.name: Triple Snoozle Morty
MortyTripleSnoozle.description: This Morty is from a dimension where Earth developed as the fourth planet from the sun after Theia settled in a stable orbit.

MortySuperMortyFan.name: Super Morty Fan Morty
MortySuperMortyFan.description: This Morty loves Mortys so much that his family had to stage an intervention to discuss his narcissistic addiction.

MortySuperRickFan.name: Super Rick Fan Morty
MortySuperRickFan.description: This Morty is a big fan of Grandpa Rick and is a fully paid member of the Rick Fan Club - a scam run by a desperate Rick who needs the money.

MortyBlob.name: Blob Morty
MortyBlob.description: This Morty is from a dimension where all the cells in his body have merged into one. He is soft and sticky to the touch and warm inside.

MortyJelly.name: Jelly Morty
MortyJelly.description: This Morty's heart dissolved long ago into the clear, pink jelly that makes up his current form. He stains anything he touches.

MortyGoo.name: Goo Morty
MortyGoo.description: This Morty is made of goo and smells like warm saline solution, body spray and shame.

MortyInfected.name: Infected Morty
MortyInfected.description: This Morty hasn’t felt right since using the public restroom of a re-fermented burger joint on a small planetoid in the inner asteroid belt of the Epsilon Eridani system.

MortyParasitic.name: Parasitic Morty
MortyParasitic.description: This Morty surprised his family by turning up at home one day after his funeral. Unsure of the best course of action, his family kept him chained up in the back yard.

MortyHost.name: Host Morty
MortyHost.description: This Morty smells like sour milk and emits deadly spores every evening, just before sunset. There is nothing left of who he used to be.

MortyStrawberry.name: Strawberry Morty
MortyStrawberry.description: This Morty was framed by his Rick for multi-dimensional omnicide and has since built a new life for himself by hiding among the strawberry people of Fragaria-Prime.

MortyOrange.name: Orange Morty
MortyOrange.description: This Morty broke away from his tour group and sampled some experimental orange candy from the off-limits research lab of his Rick’s factory complex.

MortyBanana.name: Banana Morty
MortyBanana.description: This Morty has committed several unspeakable crimes while dressed as a banana. No one has seen or heard from his Rick in three years.

MortyStoned.name: Stoned Morty
MortyStoned.description: This Morty unfortunately mistook his Rick’s "Medusa Device" for a novelty item and was unaware of the side effects from excessive skin contact.

MortyPetrified.name: Petrified Morty
MortyPetrified.description: This Morty was fully aware of the risks involved from excessive skin contact with Rick’s Medusa Device but decided the benefits outweighed the negative effects.

MortyBoulder.name: Boulder Morty
MortyBoulder.description: Rick found this Morty partially lodged inside of his experimental Medusa Device.

MortyReptile.name: Reptile Morty
MortyReptile.description: This Morty has cold blood, saving his Rick 38% in heating costs per year.

MortyRaptor.name: Raptor Morty
MortyRaptor.description: This Morty’s Rick had a crazy idea to start a theme park inhabited solely by human-dino hybrids. He ended up financially and emotionally ruined due to lack of interest.

MortySaurus.name: Mortysaurus
MortySaurus.description: This Morty opened the door, got on the floor, but never expected to be painfully transmogrified into a dinosaur by his Rick.

MortyDogBite.name: Dog Bite Morty
MortyDogBite.description: This Morty was bitten by a small dog while on a backpacking trip.

MortyDog.name: Dog Morty
MortyDog.description: This Morty has the appearance of a dog and spends his evenings howling at the moon and... well, being a dog.

MortyWerewolf.name: Werewolf Morty
MortyWerewolf.description: This Morty is cursed to spend his final days as a werewolf, tormented by the terrible things he has done. But hey, on the plus side, he does have a beautiful, shiny coat.

MortyBootCamp.name: Boot Camp Morty
MortyBootCamp.description: This Morty is from one in a string of related dimension where all Ricks are required to submit their Mortys to fight in Grand Inter-dimensional Morty War.

MortyShellShocked.name: Shell Shocked Morty
MortyShellShocked.description: This Morty is from a dimension locked deep within the Grand Inter-dimensional Morty War. He’s having a hard time forgiving himself for the things he was ordered to do to his fellow Mortys.

MortyRenegade.name: Renegade Morty
MortyRenegade.description: This Morty has gone Morty-crazy from years of pointless fighting in the Grand Inter-dimensional Morty War. He witnessed many terrible things during this time.

MortyHeadism.name: Headism Morty
MortyHeadism.description: This Morty loves the giant head in the sky. Look, see? He’s wearing the hat and everything.

MortyTurbulentJuice.name: Turbulent Juice Morty
MortyTurbulentJuice.description: In a world where muscular Mortys are coming, and they're coming strong, no Morty is safe from the power of Turbulent Juice Morty. 'Cuz he's gonna take CARE of it.

MortyJerryFan.name: Jerry Fan Morty
MortyJerryFan.description: This Morty has spent most of his life in the Jerry World theme park. He was raised by the Jerrys that work there after being accidentally abandoned by his Rick.

MortyExoskeleton.name: Exoskeleton Morty
MortyExoskeleton.description: This Morty spends his days hoping his dog doesn’t realize he's human. His favorite food is marrowbone jelly.

MortySexyDevil.name: Sexy Devil Morty
MortySexyDevil.description: This Morty has been wearing the same cheap, ill-fitting devil costume since last halloween.

MortySummer.name: Summer Morty
MortySummer.description: This Morty discovered that his Rick erased all his memories of having an older sister to “keep him from pain”. He now tries to keep her alive in his heart.

MortyJerry.name: Jerry Morty
MortyJerry.description: This Morty had a difficult life growing up and never knew his real father until he discovered a old photo album hidden among his mother’s possessions.

MortyBeth.name: Beth Morty
MortyBeth.description: This Morty never recovered from his mother leaving the family when he was young. He decided to do the only thing in his power to bring her back.

MortyRick.name: Rick Morty
MortyRick.description: This Morty was tired of always being told he was an idiot and would never have even half of the brain power that his Rick possessed.

MortyCabinBoy.name: Cabin Boy Morty
MortyCabinBoy.description: This Morty is the son of the famous pirate 'Titanic Jerry', who was responsible for one of the worst pirate ship incidents in recorded history. Cabin Boy Morty is not trusted to be lookout.

MortySwashbuckle.name: Swashbuckle Morty
MortySwashbuckle.description: This Morty once found a treasure chest of gold in the Caribbean but was tricked into trading it for a date with a mermaid, who turned out to be a reverse mermaid.

MortyCaptain.name: Cap'n Morty
MortyCaptain.description: This notorious Morty is the captain of a large vessel named Jessica's Pearl and once traded his eye for a barrel of gun powder infused rum.

MortyMiami.name: Miami Morty
MortyMiami.description: This Morty sleeps on the beach during the day and works as a dancer in a famous 80s night club. His signature dance move is The Lollipop.

MortyNewBlood.name: New Blood Morty
MortyNewBlood.description: This Morty read too many teenage novels and believed that becoming a vampire would make him more attractive to the opposite sex. Everyone he loved died long ago.

MortyCount.name: Count Morty
MortyCount.description: This Morty gave up drinking human blood in the late 50s and is now a children’s entertainer/scarer.

MortyOldOne.name: Old One Morty
MortyOldOne.description: This Morty is the oldest and most highly ranked of all Morty vampires. Despite this, the other vampires joke that his ears allow interdimensional hearing even though he is completely deaf.

MortyDenimShorts.name: Denim Shorts Morty
MortyDenimShorts.description: This Morty likes short shorts. So much so that he never takes them off, even in the shower.

MortyDoubleDenim.name: Double Denim Morty
MortyDoubleDenim.description: This Morty dares, dares to double... the denim.

MortyTripleDenim.name: Triple Denim Morty
MortyTripleDenim.description: Two’s a company, three’s a crowd. This Morty likes denim three times more than a regular Morty.

MortyCup.name: Cup Morty
MortyCup.description: This Morty has a terrible secret and would be devastated if anyone ever found out.

MortyFawn.name: Fawn Morty
MortyFawn.description: This Morty spends all his time standing in the forest clearing by the light of the full moon, waiting for the chance to see his mother’s shade pass by through the trees.

MortyNewShoot.name: Seedling Morty
MortyNewShoot.description: This Morty grows out of the ground below the recently hanged and is said to induce madness in anyone who licks him. His scream can only be heard by unsuspecting dogs.

MortyOfTheValley.name: Morty of the Valley
MortyOfTheValley.description: This Morty was the result of his Rick's attempt to bio-engineer cheap vegetable oil. Its petals cause blindness when ingested.

Mortydrangea.name: Mortydrangea
Mortydrangea.description: This Morty evolved after a Morty of the Valley acquired the taste for human flesh. Its saliva stuns and dissolves any prey that crosses its path.

MortyRookie.name: Rookie Morty
MortyRookie.description: This Morty’s first day on the beat has been complicated. His fellow Cop Mortys questioned his loyalty after opting out of the protection racket run by the precinct’s Rick.

MortyDetective.name: Detective Morty
MortyDetective.description: This Morty’s peptic ulcer burns from all those coffee-soaked nights spent investigating a quintuple Mortycide that still haunts his every waking hour.

MortyHardboiled.name: Hardboiled Morty
MortyHardboiled.description: This Morty is getting too old for this. It's his last day on the job, he’s past the point of no return, and he won't stop until his target is behind bars.
MortyHardboiled.characteristic: Loose Cannon, Doesn't Play by the Rules

MortyShallowClone.name: Poorly Cloned Morty
MortyShallowClone.description: This Morty was found by Beth and Jerry among the possessions of their deceased Rick. Unable to find the right words, they decided to raise him as Morty's twin.

MortyKitchenBoy.name: Kitchen Boy Morty
MortyKitchenBoy.description: This Morty is responsible for washing dishes, taking out the trash, and changing the fryer grease. He smells like french fries and sweat.

MortyPastryChef.name: Pastry Chef Morty
MortyPastryChef.description: This Morty’s intense chef training has left him unable to speak. He can only express his emotions through interpretive baking.

MortyHeadChef.name: Head Chef Morty
MortyHeadChef.description: This successful Morty lent his name to an animation studio, only to be horrified by the content they produce.

MortySkinSuit.name: Skin Suit Morty
MortySkinSuit.description: This Morty enjoys wandering the local park naked but didn’t want the coming winter to effect his lifestyle choice.

MortyMotionCapture.name: Motion Capture Morty
MortyMotionCapture.description: This Morty uses his whole body to help large game studios create animations for match 3 games.

MortyRainbowSuit.name: Rainbow Suit Morty
MortyRainbowSuit.description: This Morty wants to be a rainbow and can be seen standing on the edge of high buildings after the rain.

MortyLoner.name: Loner Morty
MortyLoner.description: This Morty spends his days in his small dirty apartment training for that one big moment to put the world right. He enjoys going to the cinema by himself.

MortyDangerous.name: Dangerous Morty
MortyDangerous.description: This Morty runs a small business and spends most of his time traveling the country. The way he sees it, only through total failure lies the true path to success.

MortyViolent.name: Violent Morty
MortyViolent.description: There is Morty, that is him, and his old man, that is Rick and the two would traverse the ol' interdimensionals together until alas brothers, a mishap put a right end to all that tomfoolery.

MortyBirdosaur.name: Birdosaur Morty
MortyBirdosaur.description: This mythical Morty can be found nesting in the Mortian Forest near Morty City. His tail feathers are said to smell like teenage shame.

MortyVolcan.name: Volcan Morty
MortyVolcan.description: This mythical Morty is said to appear near the homes of the recently deceased and can only be seen by labradors and people with peanut allergies.

MortyPrancer.name: Prancer Morty
MortyPrancer.description: This mythical Morty appears every time a tear drop reaches the ocean. He is said to shimmer like the moonlight reflected in a still pool.

MortyAcePilot.name: Ace Pilot Morty
MortyAcePilot.description: This ol’ Morty can’t be beat in the skies. Even when drawing crabs this old chap can be seen zigzagging around every archie and never pipped, not even once what what!

MortySurvivor.name: Survivor Morty
MortySurvivor.description: This Morty survived the original Mortyland Uprising by hiding under a pile of soiled merchandise in a gift shop. He remembers the happier times.

MortySurvivalist.name: Survivalist Morty
MortySurvivalist.description: This Morty adapted to the harsh conditions after the Mortyland Uprising, scavenging anything he could use to keep himself alive.

MortyWildMan.name: Wild Man Morty
MortyWildMan.description: This Morty lurks in the trees to hide from trainers, but will attack if they enter his territory. The distant memories of his previous life fade a little more each day...

MortyWildMascot.name: Wild Mascot Morty
MortyWildMascot.description: This Mascot Morty didn’t thrive in the chaos of the Mortyland Uprising. Unleashed from the shackles of society, he's now free to enact his perverse justice on anyone who displeases him.

MortyAnimatronic.name: Animatronic Morty
MortyAnimatronic.description: This Morty is one of the last original Morty-bots left from the Uprising that’s still functioning. It’s impossible to say how many innocent lives he took that day.

MortyPlumbusSlave.name: Plumbus Slave Morty
MortyPlumbusSlave.description: This Morty's been modified to have increased resistance to chumble spores and schleem for his janitorial assignment.

MortyPlumbusWorker.name: Plumbus Worker Morty
MortyPlumbusWorker.description: This Morty's primary function is to clean schleem from elevator shafts. He is subject to random memory sweeps and is limited to a 4 year life span.

MortyPlumbusMaster.name: Plumbus Master Morty
MortyPlumbusMaster.description: This Morty has been promoted to head of Morty Resources where he's increased the night team's productivity by 8.2%.

MortyPlumbusPrawn.name: Plumbus Prawn Morty
MortyPlumbusPrawn.description: This Morty is the result of the Morty/Plumbus protein strand exchanges that sometimes occur in hot climates during the biannual Planetary Alignment in his sector.

MortyPlumbonia.name: Plumbonia Morty
MortyPlumbonia.description: These Morty hybrids often start to appear around 6 to 9 months after a factory starts production due to tight spaces and too much repurposed Fleeb juice.

MortyArmomaly.name: Armomaly Morty
MortyArmomaly.description: This Morty is one of the results of an illegal planet-wide seeding experiment by a large transdimensional pharmaceutical conglomerate.

MortyMutagen.name: Mutagen Morty
MortyMutagen.description: This Morty's endocrine system has been chemically enhanced to produce super cortisol. He's kept in containment for further testing.

MortyCarcinogenic.name: Carcinogenic Morty
MortyCarcinogenic.description: This Morty feeds on other unsuspecting Mortys, absorbing them into his body where they are slowly digested over the course of a few weeks.

MortyMega.name: Mega Morty
MortyMega.description: This Morty has been deemed fit for mass production and is currently undergoing field tests to see how it performs in real world scenarios.

MortySpliced.name: Spliced Morty
MortySpliced.description: This Morty was created with a cocktail of DNA samples from Mortys throughout the multiverse.

MortyCrewman.name: Crewman Morty
MortyCrewman.description: This Morty is responsible for making sure all the vending machines work on C deck.

MortyEnsign.name: Ensign Morty
MortyEnsign.description: This Morty received 4-D vision from a planet that deemed eyeballs illegal. He uses his incredible visual range to man the helm.

MortyLieutenant.name: Lieutenant Morty
MortyLieutenant.description: This Morty commands the respect of his crew, believes in the merits of diplomatic negotiations, and champions the interplanetary rights of all species. He also suffers from space constipation.

MortyMortaion.name: Mortaion Morty
MortyMortaion.description: This Morty comes from a mysterious race of beautiful space sirens who all happen to look like Morty.

MortyMortox.name: Mortox Morty
MortyMortox.description: This Morty was found living on a rogue planetoid in the southeastern knot of the Cygnus loop. He can only communicate through intense stares and pulsing.

AttackPoisonSpit.name: Poison Spit
AttackPoisonSpit.description: The enemy is hit multiple times with saliva. Each hit has a small chance of poisoning.

AttackVileSpew.name: Vile Spew
AttackVileSpew.description: Morty empties his insides onto the enemy but risks poisoning both them and himself.

AttackEnergyDrain.name: Energy Drain
AttackEnergyDrain.description: Sucks life from the enemy and replenishes a small amount to the host.

AttackPillage.name: Pillage
AttackPillage.description: Knocks the enemy off guard for long enough to pilfer some health from the unlucky.

AttackBloodSuck.name: Blood Suck
AttackBloodSuck.description: Tries to suck a small amount of energy from the enemy. Risk of blood poisoning.

AttackSliceAndDice.name: Slice & Dice
AttackSliceAndDice.description: Morty throws his toppings at the enemy hitting 2 to 5 times.

AttackGooeyCheese.name: Gooey Cheese
AttackGooeyCheese.description: The enemy is hit by hot cheese. If the cheese sticks, the enemy will become paralyzed.

AttackFossilise.name: Fossilise
AttackFossilise.description: Morty pounds his enemy closer to extinction and lowers their evasion.

AttackScratchAndSniff.name: Scratch & Sniff
AttackScratchAndSniff.description: The enemy takes multiple hits. If a third hit lands, their defense is stripped away.

AttackAttention.name: Attention
AttackAttention.description: Morty stands to attention and improves some of his stats.

AttackBlitz.name: Blitz
AttackBlitz.description: Morty shoots his load at the enemy, increasing his accuracy each time and occasionally hitting.

AttackStoneFists.name: Stone Fists
AttackStoneFists.description: Morty lashes out with a one-two combo.

AttackTombstone.name: Tombstone
AttackTombstone.description: Morty drops his enemy on their head, causing big damage and a chance of paralyzing.

AttackBunchUp.name: Bunch Up
AttackBunchUp.description: Lowers the enemy's Attack and Speed but raises their Defense.

AttackSprout.name: Sprout
AttackSprout.description: Lowers the enemy's Defense and Accuracy but raises their Attack.

AttackImplode.name: Implode
AttackImplode.description: Morty implodes, causing massive damage to his enemy but dazing himself in the process.

AttackGForce.name: G-Force
AttackGForce.description: The enemy is pinned back, reducing their speed with a chance of paralyzing them.

AttackSnotBlast.name: Snot Blast
AttackSnotBlast.description: Morty sneezes with force, aiming directly at the enemy. If ingested, it will cause poison.

AttackStaticShock.name: Static Shock
AttackStaticShock.description: Morty greatly Increases his defence but may paralyze himself and his enemy.

AttackGlitterBlast.name: Glitter Blast
AttackGlitterBlast.description: Morty throws a glitter bomb at the enemy, reducing their Accuracy and Evade.

AttackScuttle.name: Scuttle
AttackScuttle.description: Attempts to sink the enemy, lowering their Accuracy and Evade.

AttackSpear.name: Spear
AttackSpear.description: Morty uses his horn to hit the enemy with a chance of paralyzing them.

AttackWetTounge.name: Wet Tongue
AttackWetTounge.description: Morty licks the enemy 2 to 4 times, increasing damage with each hit.

AttackRegenerate.name: Regenerate
AttackRegenerate.description: Morty hits the enemy, regenerating some of his own health.

AttackLoveYourself.name: Love Yourself
AttackLoveYourself.description: Morty gives himself some TLC which increases all his stats but risks paralyzing himself.

AttackFanArt.name: Fan Art
AttackFanArt.description: Morty produces fan art of questionable taste. It may make the enemy feel sick.

AttackRickyTikkiTavi.name: Ricky Tikki Tavi
AttackRickyTikkiTavi.description: Morty attempts a jab, jab, swing move - landing up to three hits on the enemy.

AttackGrieve.name: Grieve
AttackGrieve.description: Shares grief with the enemy, inflicting damage and stealing energy.

AttackSoulSearch.name: Soul Search
AttackSoulSearch.description: Searches for the answers within but only finds an urge to lash out with a potential to paralyze.

AttackCertitude.name: Certitude
AttackCertitude.description: Morty sacrifices some of his enemy’s HP for the floating head. He keeps some for himself, too.

AttackRecitation.name: Recitation
AttackRecitation.description: Morty recites the words of the headism scripture, causing mass damage but lowering his attack.

AttackJuice.name: Juice
AttackJuice.description: Morty performs a strong attack, then rejuvenates to bring back some HP. Chance of extra attack.

AttackExfoliate.name: Exfoliate
AttackExfoliate.description: Morty sheds his dried skin and feels born again with a slight stat increase all over.

AttackChastise.name: Chastise
AttackChastise.description: Morty brings his enemy’s morale down, lowering their accuracy and evade.

AttackFortify.name: Fortify
AttackFortify.description: Morty secures his surroundings, raising both defense and accuracy.

AttackStrengthen.name: Strengthen
AttackStrengthen.description: Morty Increases his defense and evade.

AttackGrab.name: Grab
AttackGrab.description: A chance of paralyzing the enemy. If successful, this will also lower their attack.

Attack666.description: The enemy Morty feels his skin tighten and becomes poisoned.

AttackInferno.name: Inferno
AttackInferno.description: Flames strike the enemy Morty. If hit three times, his speed will drop.

AttackPiracy.name: Piracy
AttackPiracy.description: Saps treasure from the enemy but risks the loss of one's morals.

AttackAerokinesis.name: Aerokinesis
AttackAerokinesis.description: Takes control of the enemy's air flow passage, causing a sudden let out with a potential to paralyze.

AttackStoneWash.name: Stone Wash
AttackStoneWash.description: Spins the enemy in sharp stones 2 to 4 times, increasing damage each time.

AttackTateOchi.name: Tate-Ochi
AttackTateOchi.description: Drains the enemy's defence and attack, leaving vertical fade lines in the process.

NPCRickPortalGuard.name: Portal Guard Rick
NPCRickPortalGuard.dialogue: This portal takes you to a random battle dimension each time you use it.*Defeat the boss Rick in each one to earn a badge.

NPCRickChambersGuard.name: Guard Rick
NPCRickChambersGuard.dialogue: Hey, respect the Council of Ricks!*Those guys are just awesome.

NPCBirdperson.name: Birdperson
NPCBirdperson.dialogue: I will always be here for you, Rick.*Just call out in pain if you need my help.

NPCMortyPlushSuit1.name: Plush Suit Morty
NPCMortyPlushSuit1.dialogue: Hey, it's Morty time!*Everyone do the Morty!

NPCMortyPlushSuit3.name: Plush Suit Morty
NPCMortyPlushSuit3.dialogue: I'm going Morty crazy for Mortys!

NPCTrainerBlerg.name: Blerg
NPCTrainerBlerg.dialogue: Once I restock my items, I'm heading back out into the wild to collect more Mortys.

NPCTrainerFlargo.name: Flargo
NPCTrainerFlargo.dialogue: I've earned so many Schmeckles from Morty battles!*Time to visit Salesman Rick's store.

NPCTrainerFlipperdeeFluflops.dialogue: Floopy floop P-Moohty doop in paa*Shoom-shoom floopy doopy poops.

NPCTrainerGagigabber.dialogue: Gagga blagga-grump Gra-Gra.*Goompa gruu Morty ga gaa Gragga.

NPCTrainerGoobagobaga.name: Goobagobaga
NPCTrainerGoobagobaga.dialogue: Garble gooba goo Chuubu Ga ga*Goorlty gagga blagga-guump.

NPCTrainerHumox5.name: Humox 5
NPCTrainerHumox5.dialogue: When I beat you, I'm going to take you to my dark place.*You won't like my dark place, Rick.

NPCTrainerJerry.name: Jerry
NPCTrainerJerry.dialogue: I've dropped my Morty off at the Day Care so I can go out and collect more!*This sure beats popping ballons, eh?

NPCTrainerMasyKallerax.name: Masy Kallerax
NPCTrainerMasyKallerax.dialogue: Everyone was into Mortys... so I got into it, too.*Mortys are super cute!

NPCTrainerPrax.name: Prax
NPCTrainerPrax.dialogue: Where do you get a drink around here?*I need a break.

NPCTrainerPriix.name: Priix
NPCTrainerPriix.dialogue: I spent the kids' college fund on some sweet stuff at Salesman Rick's!*Don't tell anyone.

NPCTrainerShmupiedoop.name: Shmupiedoop
NPCTrainerShmupiedoop.dialogue: Shlerpple those Mortys up, Rick.*You can never have too much backup!

NPCTrainerSnisserchoops.name: Snisserchoops
NPCTrainerSnisserchoops.dialogue: Prrr snoozeeee P-Prrrrrr bloop*Prrrr Prrrr Mmmmm

NPCTrainerSnoofySnooples.name: Snoofy Snooples
NPCTrainerSnoofySnooples.dialogue: SNOOFY SNOO Prrrr Prrrr Moo Moo!

NPCTrainerToopee.name: Toopee
NPCTrainerToopee.dialogue: I lost a battle to some jerk with three Green Shirt Mortys.*GREEN!

NPCTrainerTuuieTumtops.name: Tuuie Tumtops
NPCTrainerTuuieTumtops.dialogue: One of my Mortys blinked while getting healed at the Healing Center.*It wasn't pretty. Bits of Morty went everywhere.

NPCTrainerXqutoopikk.dialogue: Xyykaa Xquxaa xq Xkk-k M-ortky*Xaa xu xyykaaxx!

NPCTrainerZannabox.dialogue: Wooo zu wazzle zanna Wooo woo wick.*Zanna zanna woo...

NPCTrainerZanQuattaxa.dialogue: Xxxk qxaa xq kik Xquaxx M-ortky*Xxxk t 0.40 - 10hz Xkaaxa xu?

NPCRickLost.name: Grateful Rick
NPCRickLost.dialogue: Can you believe the Healing Center is free to use?*It's Rickdiculous.

NPCRickHippy.name: Happy Rick
NPCRickHippy.dialogue: The world is beautiful 'buurp'.*It's just beautiful.

NPCRickDreamy.name: Dreamy Rick
NPCRickDreamy.dialogue: One day I'll have my own statue.*It'll be beautiful, you'll see!

NPCRickHopeful.name: Hopeful Rick
NPCRickHopeful.dialogue: I want to be the very best.*Like no one ever was.

NPCRickShopping.name: Shopaholic Rick
NPCRickShopping.dialogue: Salesman Rick has some sweet stuff.*If only I had more Schmeckles, I'd buy the lot.

NPCRickAbusive.name: Helpful Rick
NPCRickAbusive.dialogue: Got a dazed Morty?* Heal him at the Healing Center for free.

NPCRickTrainer.name: Insightful Rick
NPCRickTrainer.dialogue: Got two Mortys of the same kind?*Combine them at the Morty Day Care to create an even better Morty!

NPCRickOptimistic.name: Revengeful Rick
NPCRickOptimistic.dialogue: Some Rick stole my badge.*I'm gonna win it back when I find him.

NPCRickNewest.name: Novice Rick
NPCRickNewest.dialogue: I heard about this Morty craze and I want in!

NPCRickCollector.name: Completionist Rick
NPCRickCollector.dialogue: I heard there's a Morty that's just a big head!*I hope I get the chance to catch one!

NPCRickFuture.name: Careless Rick
NPCRickFuture.dialogue: Damn. I lost my Blips and Chitz coupon.*I've been to so many dimensions, I'm never going to find it now.

NPCRickBald.name: Bald Rick
NPCRickBald.dialogue: If you find a crafting recipe for hair, let me know!

NPCRickDoofus.name: Doofus Rick
NPCRickDoofus.dialogue: Oh. Hey, Rick. How's it going?*We should hang out sometime, catch a movie...*I hear Planet of the Ricks is awesome.

NPCRickFlatTop.name: Flat Top Rick
NPCRickFlatTop.dialogue: How come all these aliens get to collect Mortys, too?*It's not right! Don't they have their own minions to play with?

NPCRickGlasses.name: Four Eyes Rick
NPCRickGlasses.dialogue: What you looking at, Rick?*Do I have something on my face?

NPCRickChain.name: Junk Yard Rick
NPCRickChain.dialogue: Your taste in music sucks, Rick.*Get out of my personal space.

NPCRickMustache.name: Mustache Rick
NPCRickMustache.dialogue: Hey, if you see a Rick with a beard, tell him it's not the 70's anymore.

NPCRickMortyFan.name: Super Fan Rick
NPCRickMortyFan.dialogue: M-m-m-m Mortys! I love me a Morty.*Oooh, your Mortys look cool! I gotta catch a few of my own, real ones!

NPCRickFringe.name: Zero Rick
NPCRickFringe.dialogue: This place reminds me why I hate going outside.*But, if I stay in, I have to put up with my family. I can't win.

NPCTournExteriorRick1.name: Morty Games Rick
NPCTournExteriorRick1.dialogue: Welcome to The Morty Games. Please supervise your Mortys at all times. Have a nice day!

NPCTournExteriorRick2.name: Morty Games Rick
NPCTournExteriorRick2.dialogue: Welcome to The Morty Games. Head inside to compete for Morty prizes!

NPCTournExteriorRickLocked.name: Morty Games Rick
NPCTournExteriorRickLocked.dialogue: The Morty Games are still being set up.*It should be open by the time you've beaten two council members.

NPCKingJellybean.name: Mr Jellybean
NPCKingJellybean.dialogue: Oh, hey there!*Gosh, I do enjoy watching a good Morty battle. They sure do like to get physical.*One day I hope to catch my own.

NPCTournBirdperson.name: Birdperson
NPCTournBirdperson.dialogue: If you are struggling to beat an event, Dirty Rick at the Rick or Treat stall might be able to help you.

NPCTournRickBasic1.name: Beard Rick
NPCTournRickBasic1.dialogue: Are you going to enter an event in The Morty Games? I hear they're giving away unique Mortys to the winners.

NPCTournRickBasic2.name: Careless Rick
NPCTournRickBasic2.dialogue: My Morty went to the bathroom ages ago and still hasn't come back...

NPCTournRickBasic3.name: Super Fan Rick
NPCTournRickBasic3.dialogue: I can't wait for the next event! I'll be cheering for you, Rick.

NPCTournRickBasic4.name: Bald Rick
NPCTournRickBasic4.dialogue: I heard rumours that Mr. Sneezy is backstage. I hope I can get an autograph!

NPCTournRickBasic5.name: Completionist Rick
NPCTournRickBasic5.dialogue: Every time you enter an event, you will get to choose from a list of Mortys and Items.*Make sure you pick a good team for that round.

NPCTournGhost.name: Ghost Rick
NPCTournGhost.dialogue: I'll never give up on you, Morty.*I know you're out there... somewhere.

TrainerTutorial.name: Masy Kallerax
TrainerTutorial.dialogueprebattle1: Hey, you like collecting Mortys, too? I just got my first one.*Everyone's going crazy for Morty collecting. You’ll find lots of trainers looking to battle their Mortys.*It's a great way of training them up. Let's battle now!
TrainerTutorial.dialoguepostbattle: You are strong! Having more Mortys sure does help in a battle, and using the right types can mean the difference between winning and losing.*You should keep following the path until you find the Rick of this dimension. Beat him and you'll earn a badge!*Want to be the very best? Collect badges so everyone will know how great you are!

TrainerTutorialGymLeader.name: Mysterious Rick
TrainerTutorialGymLeader.dialogueprebattle1: You again!*I’ve healed and leveled up my Morty. This time, I’m going to win.
TrainerTutorialGymLeader.dialoguepostbattle: Not again!*As the Rick of this dimension, I am obligated to give you this badge. Don't let it get to your head.*Here, I'll open up a portal to take you home...*It will be my pleasure.

TrainerBaloogieMellow.name: Baloogie Mellow
TrainerBaloogieMellow.dialogueprebattle1: I’m the best Morty wangler in this trans-dimensional branch and you’re gonna get it!
TrainerBaloogieMellow.dialogueprebattle2: Stop right there, Rick!*My Mortys are primed for battle. I hope yours are, too.
TrainerBaloogieMellow.dialogueprebattle3: Hey, Rick. Enjoying this dimension? I think you've seen enough of it.*I'm about to beat you and send your little party all the way back to the Citadel.
TrainerBaloogieMellow.dialoguepostbattle: Screw you, Rick!*You'll pay for what you've done after I've healed my Mortys.

TrainerBlerg.name: Blerg
TrainerBlerg.dialogueprebattle1: Blarg flargen glag Morty ga blooen den rago frorg lesten Morty glag blarg gon ga rago glag Morty blarg!*Flargen Morty glag rago battle flargo!
TrainerBlerg.dialogueprebattle2: Fraggen toobee tuk, blooen raga lestrana, Morty goom blarg g grango baggen?
TrainerBlerg.dialogueprebattle3: Blerg-Kan, pro blerg-kan den raga blerg frorg glag g Morty fuh 'Human Pockets' glag...
TrainerBlerg.dialoguepostbattle: You... you parasite! I'll get you next time Rick. Just you wait.

TrainerBluu.name: Bluu
TrainerBluu.dialogueprebattle1: Bluu doesn't like Rick.*Bluu wants to teach Rick lesson.
TrainerBluu.dialogueprebattle2: Bluu is strong. Bluu is clever.*Bluu is gunna win.
TrainerBluu.dialogueprebattle3: Bluu is not in the mood for losing to stupid Rick.*Bluu will win easy.
TrainerBluu.dialoguepostbattle: Bluu not happy with Bluu's performance today.*Bluu does not want to see Rick's face again.

TrainerFlargo.dialogueprebattle1: Not so quick, Rick.*I challenge you to a battle!

TrainerJerry.name: Jerry
TrainerJerry.dialogueprebattle1: Hey, Rick! I think I'm getting the hang of Morty battling.*Go easy though, nobody likes a bad sport.

TrainerMasyKallerax.name: Masy Kallerax
TrainerMasyKallerax.dialogueprebattle1: This is so much fun!*My Mortys are just the best. They feel like family already.*I'm so jealous you get to be related for real.*Shall we let them play together?
TrainerMasyKallerax.dialogueprebattle2: I was just chatting with my Mortys. They're so darn funny!*I know they moan a bit before battle, but I can see how much they enjoy it after the first few rounds.
TrainerMasyKallerax.dialoguepostbattle: Ah, Rick, I'm sorry my Mortys didn't put up much of a fight.*I'm sure they will try harder next time.

TrainerPrax.name: Prax
TrainerPrax.dialogueprebattle1: I've got my eye on you, Rick. No funny business, okay?*Let's play by the rules.
TrainerPrax.dialogueprebattle2: I have just rememberd, I left the stove on.*Let's have one quick battle, then I must get home pronto.
TrainerPrax.dialoguepostbattle: Wow, my Mortys are useless. I think I'll release them and find some new ones.

TrainerPriix.name: Priix
TrainerPriix.dialogueprebattle1: I've given more attention to my Mortys than I have to my own kids.*If you think you're a more dedicated trainer than me, you are very much mistaken.
TrainerPriix.dialogueprebattle2: My Mortys call me Mom.*You'll never have that bond, Rick. They will never love you like mine love me.*They won't let Mother down this time.
TrainerPriix.dialoguepostbattle: How dare you, Rick!? My poor little Mortys, all dazed and confused.*You'll be hearing from my lawyer!

TrainerShmupiedoop.dialogueprebattle2: Blarble starble, if it's not Rick the Schmick!*I hear you think you can go all the way. Well, I'm here to put a stop to that.
TrainerShmupiedoop.dialoguepostbattle: Oh hell, Rick! No need to get all up in my grill.*Get out of here!

TrainerToopee.dialoguepostbattle: Damn, Rick, just take it easy, yeah?*Mortys don't grow on trees!

TrainerTuuieTumtops.dialogueprebattle1: My Mortys have been acting weird since I combined them at Morty Day Care.*No matter-- they're stronger than ever. You don't stand a chance!

TrainerTuuieTumtops.dialoguepostbattle: Well, color me orange. I wasn't expecting such a showdown.

TrainerGymLeader1.name: Alien Rick
