TrainerGymLeader2.name: Aqua Rick
TrainerGymLeader2.dialogueprebattle1: You think you've got what it takes to defeat me?*Ha, good luck with that!
TrainerGymLeader2.dialogueprebattle2: This is the Rick you'll wish you had never challenged.*Don’t be to hard on yourself when you lose.
TrainerGymLeader2.dialoguepostbattle: Damn you, Rick! Look at my Morty! They don't even know which day it is. Get out!

TrainerGymLeader3.name: Bald Rick
TrainerGymLeader3.dialogueprebattle1: This is my time to shine! I'm taking you down, Rick!
TrainerGymLeader3.dialogueprebattle2: I’m going to beat you and it is going to be glorious!*You don’t stand a chance.
TrainerGymLeader3.dialoguepostbattle: That's not how this was meant to end!*Luck was on your side this time, Rick.

TrainerGymLeader4.name: Beard Rick
TrainerGymLeader4.dialogueprebattle1: If you want a badge, you're going to have to get through me!*Commence battle!
TrainerGymLeader4.dialogueprebattle2: House Rules, Rick. No dirty moves and keep your Mortys under control at all times.*Let's go!
TrainerGymLeader4.dialoguepostbattle: You make me so mad, Rick. One of these days I'm going to take you down.

TrainerGymLeader5.name: Bubble Gum Rick
TrainerGymLeader5.dialogueprebattle1: You're going to look mighty silly when you're the one with gum all over your face, Rick!
TrainerGymLeader5.dialogueprebattle2: I’m on my last piece of gum so let's make this quick.
TrainerGymLeader5.dialoguepostbattle: I never did like you, Rick!* Take this badge and get out of here.

TrainerGymLeader6.name: Cowboy Rick
TrainerGymLeader6.dialogueprebattle1: Howdy 'buurp'! I'm the sheriff around these parts.*I beat outlaws like you all the time. You won't be taking my badge from me that easily, partner!
TrainerGymLeader6.dialogueprebattle2: Out West, a man must put up if he's to see what kind of a’ Morty he’s been a' raising.* Are you such a man, Rick? Or are you just a no-good, dimension-hopping toad?
TrainerGymLeader6.dialoguepostbattle: You're no partner of mine. Get out of here!

TrainerGymLeader7.name: Cyclops Rick
TrainerGymLeader7.dialogueprebattle1: You think you can beat me just because you've got an extra eye?*Let's do this!
TrainerGymLeader7.dialogueprebattle2: What I lack in depth perception, I make up in kick-ass Mortys.*You're going down, Rick.
TrainerGymLeader7.dialoguepostbattle: Get out, out! I'd rather lose my eye than see you again.

TrainerGymLeader8.name: Dandy Rick
TrainerGymLeader8.dialogueprebattle1: Oh, dearest Rick, the mark of a good Morty is how far he will battle for his Rick against all others and against all odds, and I must say...* My Mortys are so very, very good...
TrainerGymLeader8.dialogueprebattle2: Rick, darling! What terrible fate would make such playthings of us all that we must place our Mortys at odds with one another?*Oh, terrible fate...
TrainerGymLeader8.dialoguepostbattle: What tragedy befalls Dandy Rick this day? Oh, woe is me!

TrainerGymLeader9.name: Doofus Rick
TrainerGymLeader9.dialogueprebattle1: Don’t make fun of my Mortys, Rick. They're the best I have.*I’m just getting good! Look, I’ll show you.
TrainerGymLeader9.dialogueprebattle2: If your Mortys mean something to you, that is all that matters.*Be kind and gentle and they will love you in return.
TrainerGymLeader9.dialoguepostbattle: Don't rub it in, Rick. I know I lost. I never win anything.

TrainerGymLeader10.name: Evil Rick
TrainerGymLeader10.dialogueprebattle1: We are a lot alike, you and I.*Except I'm going to win this battle and you are not!
TrainerGymLeader10.dialogueprebattle2: I’m taking all the Mortys I catch back to my dimension and you're not going to stop me.*Your Mortys don’t even look like they're worth it. Do your worst!
TrainerGymLeader10.dialoguepostbattle: Is that the best you can do, Rick? I barely felt a scratch.

TrainerGymLeader11.name: Flat Top Rick
TrainerGymLeader11.dialogueprebattle1: Hey, I’m the Rick that has flat hair. That's me, Flat Top Rick. That's what they call me.*So, let's battle.
TrainerGymLeader11.dialogueprebattle2: My hair is flat. But only on the top. I keep it a bit shorter on the sides but on the top it's just plain flat.*So, let's battle.
TrainerGymLeader11.dialoguepostbattle: Maybe I need to spend more time training my Mortys and less time on my hair...

TrainerGymLeader12.name: Four Eyes Rick
TrainerGymLeader12.dialogueprebattle1: I have assessed the situation and the probability of me winning this battle is rather high.*Let's see if you can beat the odds, Rick.
TrainerGymLeader12.dialogueprebattle2: I ran a simulation of this battle and I can assure you that there is no way you can win.
TrainerGymLeader12.dialoguepostbattle: I need to get my vision checked. For a minute there, it looked like you won…

TrainerGymLeader13.name: Guard Rick
TrainerGymLeader13.dialogueprebattle1: No one gets past me!*You will be no different.
TrainerGymLeader13.dialogueprebattle2: I'm going to beat you and stop you from earning my badge so you can’t battle the council!
TrainerGymLeader13.dialoguepostbattle: Please, don't tell the council that I failed them.

TrainerGymLeader14.name: Guilty Rick
TrainerGymLeader14.dialogueprebattle1: In years to come, the other Ricks will look back on this battle with fond memories.
TrainerGymLeader14.dialogueprebattle2: I’ve seen things, Rick.*Terrible, Morty-related things.
TrainerGymLeader14.dialoguepostbattle: My Mortys will go down with the truth and I shall never speak of it.

TrainerGymLeader15.name: Junk Yard Rick
TrainerGymLeader15.dialogueprebattle1: Think you're hard enough to beat me?*My Mortys have done unspeakable things and they'll do them again!
TrainerGymLeader15.dialogueprebattle2: I found a new Morty in a pile of junk while I was out in my yard.*I think he had been out there for weeks. Let's see how he battles.
TrainerGymLeader15.dialoguepostbattle: That's it. I’m releasing all of my Mortys and finding new ones.

TrainerGymLeader16.name: Miami Rick
TrainerGymLeader16.dialogueprebattle1: Have you ever watched the sunset, Rick?*Maybe you'll have time tonight while you're licking your wounds.
TrainerGymLeader16.dialogueprebattle2: I left the beach for this?*You'd better make it worth my while, Rick.
TrainerGymLeader16.dialoguepostbattle: I think I've been in the sun for too long. I need to lie down for a bit.

TrainerGymLeader17.name: Mustache Rick
TrainerGymLeader17.dialogueprebattle1: I don't quite see the point of all this, but if we must!
TrainerGymLeader17.dialogueprebattle2: I feel I should be above all of this battling.*But a Rick's got to do what a Rick's got to do.
TrainerGymLeader17.dialoguepostbattle: Did you cheat? This can’t be right. I demand a replay.

TrainerGymLeader18.name: Novelist Rick
TrainerGymLeader18.dialogueprebattle1: I’m the best-selling author on Morty battling.*Let me show you how real Morty training is done!
TrainerGymLeader18.dialogueprebattle2: I have almost finished writing my guides for combining, crafting, and questing!*Let me see if this battle reveals anything I’ve missed.
TrainerGymLeader18.dialoguepostbattle: I think I’m going to leave this chapter out of my next book.

TrainerGymLeader19.name: Robot Rick
TrainerGymLeader19.dialogueprebattle1: I just upgraded my RAM, so you're in big trouble.*Run C:\Users\Rick\Battle.prog.
TrainerGymLeader19.dialogueprebattle2: Wrong time to be battling me, Rick. I just had a clean install.*Run C:\Users\Rick\Battle.prog.
TrainerGymLeader19.dialoguepostbattle: I need more upgrades! Next time you see me, I'll be more powerful than ever.

TrainerGymLeader20.name: Shibuya Rick
TrainerGymLeader20.dialogueprebattle1: You think you have what it takes to beat me, Rick?*It's all about mind over matter.
TrainerGymLeader20.dialogueprebattle2: We can battle, Rick. Just don't get my clothes dirty.*It takes work to look this good, Rick. I don't need you messing it up.
TrainerGymLeader20.dialoguepostbattle: My Morty's power level must be too low. I need to train more.

TrainerGymLeader21.name: Super Fan Rick
TrainerGymLeader21.dialogueprebattle1: Your Mortys look so cool! Let me see them.*They look like they're no match for my Mortys. Let's find out!
TrainerGymLeader21.dialogueprebattle2: I used all my coupons at a Blips and Chitz machine. Now I have all these cool Mortys.*Let's see how well they battle.
TrainerGymLeader21.dialoguepostbattle: Wow, what a battle! Let's go collect more Mortys from new dimensions and do it again.

TrainerGymLeader22.name: The Scientist Known As Rick
TrainerGymLeader22.dialogueprebattle1: I hear your mother was never satisfied, Rick.*Does it hurt?
TrainerGymLeader22.dialogueprebattle2: Nothing compares to me. Do you want to know what it feels like when Ricks cry?
TrainerGymLeader22.dialoguepostbattle: I'd like you to leave now, Rick. I need some alone time.

TrainerGymLeader23.name: Zero Rick
TrainerGymLeader23.dialogueprebattle1: I don't even care if I win or lose.*Nothing matters anyway, the world will go on without us.
TrainerGymLeader23.dialogueprebattle2: I guess we could battle, but it’s not like it will change anything, Rick.*Our existence means very little and this battle will most likely get lost in history.
TrainerGymLeader23.dialoguepostbattle: You won. It’s a shame no one else cares.

TrainerGymLeader24.name: Mysterious Rick
TrainerGymLeader24.dialogueprebattle1: This time I'm taking your Morty, Rick! Then I’m taking on the council to become the very best!*Look at him. So sweet, so tender. Let us battle!
TrainerGymLeader24.dialogueprebattle2: The council keeps telling me that I’m not good enough to battle them!*But I’ll show them... I’ll show all the Ricks that I’m the best!
TrainerGymLeader24.dialoguepostbattle: Lost again? This isn’t fair!*I'm the best Rick! You’ll see, one day I will show you all!

TrainerCouncil1.name: Rick Prime
TrainerCouncil1.dialogueprebattle1: So, you found your way back here without getting killed?*I guess you've earned my attention. Let's battle!
TrainerCouncil1.dialoguepostbattle: Beginner's luck, Rick! Don't get too cocky.*Wait, you thought that's all you needed to do to get your portal gun back?*It's not going to be that easy, Rick. I don't even have it.*Come back when you have {0} badges and maybe you'll be closer.

TrainerCouncil2.name: Quantum Rick
TrainerCouncil2.dialogueprebattle1: Ah, Rick, just because you have enough badges doesn't mean you'll win.*I've been looking forward to putting you in your place.
TrainerCouncil2.dialoguepostbattle: Gah! You're stronger than you look, but no less twisted.*I think you need to do some more training before we can trust you. You need to learn some respect for the Council.*Now get out! I don't want to see you back here until you have {0} badges.

TrainerCouncil3.name: Maximums Rickimus
TrainerCouncil3.dialogueprebattle1: We've been having fun looking through your portal gun history, Rick. Maybe we'll publish a book on it.*Let's get this battle out of the way so I can return to laughing at your pointless life.
TrainerCouncil3.dialoguepostbattle: Well well well, someone's been training! At least you have some meaning in your life now, Rick.*Thing is, you still can't have your portal gun back. It's given some of the other Ricks pink eye.*We need to do some tests to make sure it's safe. Come back when you have {0} badges and we'll talk.

TrainerCouncil4.name: Zeta Alpha Rick
TrainerCouncil4.dialogueprebattle1: We did a swab test on your portal gun, Rick. You should really see a specialist.*I'll battle you, but don't come too close.
TrainerCouncil4.dialoguepostbattle: Those were some dirty tactics, Rick. Why are you so hell-bent on causing trouble?*We're trying our best to help you, to show you the errors of your ways, but you won't even help yourself.*Come back when you have {0} badges... and some self-respect.

TrainerCouncil5.name: Ricktiminus Sancheziminius
TrainerCouncil5.dialogueprebattle1: You've come so far, Rick. So far, but in such poor style.*Didn't you ever learn style, Rick? Let me show you.
TrainerCouncil5.dialoguepostbattle: You call that style? Kicking a man when he's down?*I'm half inclined to give you your portal gun back just so we don't have to deal with you anymore.*But that would be foolish. Come back when you have {0} badges. Dismissed!

QuestJerry1.description: Jerry needs a new battery for the TV remote.
QuestJerry1.activedialogue: Rick! I’ve been looking for you everywhere!*The battery in the TV remote has run out and I can't find any replacements in the house. Can you find one for me?
QuestJerry1.rejectdialogue: That doesn't work, Rick!*The remote is still dead. I need a battery!
QuestJerry1.acceptdialogue: Yes, finally! Now I can catch up on the episodes of The Personal Space Show that I've missed.*I found this wedged down the side of the couch. I think it's yours.

QuestDoofusRick1.name: Rickstoring the Balance
QuestDoofusRick1.description: Doofus Rick wants to restore his Morty's AP.
QuestDoofusRick1.activedialogue: My Mortys' AP has run out and they can't attack anymore!*Healing Center Rick is being mean to me. He won't restore them.*Can you find me an item that will restore a Morty's AP?
QuestDoofusRick1.rejectdialogue: That isn't working. I need something that restores a Morty's AP.
QuestDoofusRick1.acceptdialogue: Thanks, Rick! I'll use this to restore my Mortys' AP.*Here, take this as a token of our new friendship.
QuestDoofusRick1.completedialogue: Thanks again, Rick. You're a true friend!

QuestRobotRick1.name: Feeling Rickcharged
QuestRobotRick1.activedialogue: Beep... Beep... Beep...*Reboot failed - low battery.*System shutting down.
QuestRobotRick1.rejectdialogue: Energy source rejected - insufficient power.*Try alternative energy source.
QuestRobotRick1.acceptdialogue: Power source accepted!*System rebooting...*Ding! Thank you, Rick!*I was trying to upgrade to the latest firmware but a power surge caused my battery to blow out.*This new battery should give me the power I need to invade... I mean, visit other dimensions!*This was jammed in my exhaust pipe. Maybe you can find a use for it.
QuestRobotRick1.completedialogue: This battery is great. I have so much energy for Morty battling now!

QuestMasyKallerax.name: New Chef in the Rickchen
QuestMasyKallerax.description: Masy needs a Purified Fleeb to make some special brownies.
QuestMasyKallerax.activedialogue: Hey, Rick. I want to bake some brownies for my Mortys-- a treat for all their hard work!*I hear triple chocolate brownies with a splash of Purified Fleeb juice will do wonders for their stamina.*But I can't find a Purified Fleeb anywhere. Can you craft one for me?
QuestMasyKallerax.rejectdialogue: That's not a Purified Fleeb, Rick. Please come back when you've crafted one.
QuestMasyKallerax.acceptdialogue: A Purified Fleeb! This should give my brownies an extra kick. My Mortys will be so pleased.*Here, I found this strange-looking egg but can't get it to hatch. Maybe it needs maturing....
QuestMasyKallerax.completedialogue: You should try my brownies, Rick! They are the best!

QuestRickTheScientistKnownAs.name: A Rick and His Morty
QuestRickTheScientistKnownAs.description: The Scientist Known as Rick wants a collar for his favorite Morty.
QuestRickTheScientistKnownAs.activedialogue: The Morty Day Care center keeps mixing up my Mortys with all the others.*To be honest, I'm not even sure myself, sometimes. They all look the same!*Could you craft a collar for my favorite Morty so I'll know that he's mine?
QuestRickTheScientistKnownAs.rejectdialogue: I don’t think I can write his name on that and have him wear it! I need something else.
QuestRickTheScientistKnownAs.acceptdialogue: That's perfect! No more mixups at Morty Day Care.*Fashionable, too-- my Morty will be very pleased.*Here, take this for your trouble.
QuestRickTheScientistKnownAs.completedialogue: Thank you, again, for the collar, Rick.

QuestFourEyesRick.name: A Matter of Rick or Death
QuestFourEyesRick.description: Four Eyes Rick wants to experiment with some Dark Energy.
QuestFourEyesRick.activedialogue: I’ve heard you can combine Dark Energy with something to make a new, powerful source of matter. I need to try this out, Rick. You must help me.*You see, I don't even have the recipe for Dark Energy.*Work out how to craft Dark Energy, then bring it to me. Do it, Rick!
QuestFourEyesRick.rejectdialogue: Does that look like Dark Energy to you, Rick? No, no it doesn’t.
QuestFourEyesRick.acceptdialogue: Dark Energy! Just what I need.*Here, take these leftover materials and leave me in peace.
QuestFourEyesRick.completedialogue: I've no use for you, Rick. Leave me alone.

QuestRobotRick2.name: Rickbooting a New Life
QuestRobotRick2.activedialogue: Beep... Beep... Rick..k..k.*Lo..gi..ii..i...c fa..ii..ling.*Hardware corrupt, System shutting down.
QuestRobotRick2.rejectdialogue: Replacement part failed.*Motherboard damaged. System shutting down.
QuestRobotRick2.acceptdialogue: Motherboard installed.*System rebooting...*Beep... Rick, that supercharged battery you gave me was too powerful. It fried my Motherboard.*Thanks for finding me a new one. I feel like I could take over the Multiverse one Morty at a time!*I mean, thank you, Rick. Take this and let us never talk about who's taking over who again.
QuestRobotRick2.completedialogue: I’ll only use this Motherboard for good, Rick.

QuestDandyRick1.name: This Rick Must Fly
QuestDandyRick1.description: Dandy Rick needs fuel for his flying car and wants your help.
QuestDandyRick1.activedialogue: Good day to you! I don’t suppose you have a moment to help out a fellow Rick?*It would appear my flying car has run out of fuel and the Morty that normally fills her up has been dazed.*Unfortunately, before he fell into this state of disrepute, he failed to tell me what I should use to fuel my car.*If you could work it out and bring the item back to me, I'm quite sure I can make it worth your while.
QuestDandyRick1.rejectdialogue: That doesn't seem to be working, Rick. I need fuel for my flying car to make her purr again.
QuestDandyRick1.acceptdialogue: That's it, Rick! You got her going again!*I released my useless Morty back into the wild. Here, you can have his chip. I don’t need it anymore.
QuestDandyRick1.completedialogue: Now, where did I park my car?

QuestJerry2.name: The Love Ricktor
QuestJerry2.description: Jerry wants to rekindle his love with Beth.
QuestJerry2.activedialogue: Rick, this is kind of embarrassing to ask, but, well…*Beth and I are going through a bit of a rough patch and, well, I was wondering if you could help me out.*Now, I know you're not my biggest fan, but we should think of the kids. Also, you don’t pay any rent, so... you kind of owe me this, Rick.*Can you find something that will convince Beth to fall in love with me all over again?
QuestJerry2.rejectdialogue: That doesn't look like something that would make Beth fall in love with me. Can we try something else?
QuestJerry2.acceptdialogue: A Love Potion? Do these things really work?!*I guess it's worth a try. I’ll sneak it into Beth’s wine tonight.*I was going to ask a Meeseeks for advice, but I guess I don’t need this anymore!
QuestJerry2.completedialogue: I’ve never heard of a Love Potion, but it’s worth a try!

QuestFlargo1.name: Just in the Rick of Time
QuestFlargo1.activedialogue: Rick, quick! I need your help. I cloned myself but it went wrong!*Now my clone is chasing me. He wants me dead so he can take my Schmeckles, Rick! I’ve tried escaping to a different dimension, but he keeps finding me.*If I had something to manipulate time, I could try jumping to a different timeline. Do you have anything like that?
QuestFlargo1.rejectdialogue: That's not helping, Rick. I’m still here.
QuestFlargo1.acceptdialogue: That's it! With this crystal, I can split time and hide from my clone.*Thanks, Rick! If you see the alternate me, don’t tell him where I am! Here's your Schmeckles.
QuestFlargo1.completedialogue: Thanks, Rick. Remember, you didn’t see me and I didn't see you.

QuestBluu.name: The Ricktatorship
QuestBluu.description: Bluu wants a robot. Probably for world domination.
QuestBluu.activedialogue: Bluu wants to be on the Council. Bluu will be a fair leader.*Bluu will offer Mortycare with every Morty. Bluu will give the people Free Lunch Thursdays.*Bluu just asks for a small donation towards his Robot Army.
QuestBluu.rejectdialogue: Bluu is not satisfied. Bluu wants a working robot.
QuestBluu.acceptdialogue: Bluu is grateful for your donation to his Robot Army. Bluu will spare your life when the time comes. Bluu wants you to take these and have some fun.
QuestBluu.completedialogue: Bluu wants you to enjoy your time as a free man.

QuestHumox.name: Ricktastrophe of the 4th Kind
QuestHumox.description: Humox would like to blow up his home planet.
QuestHumox.activedialogue: Rick, the Multiverse is an eternal pool of pain and injustice. Each dimension is its own cruel mistress playing with life and death.*My people suffer through endless wars, slaves to countless races. I believe that we have experienced our fair share of life’s wicked games-- our time has come.*We must ascend to a higher place to end the suffering and be free.*Can you help me free my people, Rick?
QuestHumox.rejectdialogue: This will not end our suffering, Rick. We must go out with a bang.
QuestHumox.acceptdialogue: This will work just fine, Rick.*I will take this to my home planet and I will free them from the shackles of life. They will thank you for your kindness in the next life, Rick.*As you have helped me, I will help you, too. Here-- my people will need these no longer.
QuestHumox.completedialogue: I will remain in this life, continuing to train my Mortys while telling tales of your heroism and the freedom of my people.

QuestFlargo2.name: Rick Around the Clock
QuestFlargo2.activedialogue: So, you’re the Rick that gave that clone a time crystal?*I'll bet he told you I was the evil one and wanted to kill him, right? Well, then he's fooled us both!*He's the evil one, Rick. He attacked me and took all my Schmeckles! You need to fix this, Rick. Find me some way to stabilize time.
QuestFlargo2.rejectdialogue: That’s not going to get him back, Rick. We need something to stabilize time.
QuestFlargo2.acceptdialogue: That’s it! With this collar I can stabilize time and get my Schmeckles back.*My clone dropped these before he ran away. You can have them.
QuestFlargo2.completedialogue: You’ve done a good thing today, Rick. There can be only one Flargo...

QuestJerry3.name: Butter Me Up, Rick
QuestJerry3.description: Jerry is struggling to reach the butter for his toast.
QuestJerry3.activedialogue: Rick! Thank the Lord, I found you! There’s an emergency at the house and you’re needed right away.*My toast just popped but I can’t reach the butter at the back of the fridge. Beth is out and the toast is starting to get cold!*Can you craft a device to help me?
QuestJerry3.rejectdialogue: I don’t see how that is going to help me get to the butter, Rick.
QuestJerry3.acceptdialogue: That’s genius! Wait until Beth gets home and sees this.*Thanks, Rick. Here, take this. I found it in the second freezer drawer... but it tastes awful.
QuestJerry3.completedialogue: I don’t feel so great... I probably just need to eat something.

QuestDoofusRick2.name: Ricktelligence Quotient
QuestDoofusRick2.description: Doofus Rick wants to improve his IQ to become better at Morty battling.
QuestDoofusRick2.activedialogue: Hey, Rick-- you know I'm not stupid, right? All the other Ricks are making fun of me and my Mortys.*I can’t take it anymore, Rick. I want to show them I can be the very best, too!*Hey, I don’t suppose you could help me out? You know, craft me something to show them I'm not a doofus?
QuestDoofusRick2.rejectdialogue: I’m not sure if that will make me seem any more intelligent to the other Ricks.*Maybe there's something else you can craft?
QuestDoofusRick2.acceptdialogue: Wow, Rick! That looks great. They're going to be sorry they messed with me.*I don't need these anymore. Here-- take them, friend.
QuestDoofusRick2.completedialogue: It fits great, Rick. You are so kind to me.

QuestBaloogyMellow.name: The Cable Rick
QuestBaloogyMellow.description: Baloogie wants a new way to watch TV.
QuestBaloogyMellow.activedialogue: The TV in this place is awful. I’ve seen every episode of Tony McQuire: Gun For Hire twice now.*Even the hit show My Dead Wife & Me is starting to lose its appeal.*I need something new to watch, Rick. Can you hook me up?
QuestBaloogyMellow.rejectdialogue: I can’t watch TV on that, Rick. I need something that can get TV from all dimensions.
QuestBaloogyMellow.acceptdialogue: Rick, this is amazing! They have everything on here. They even have the show That Doesn’t Fit In There in Super Ultra HD!*I’m going to take a break from Morty battling for a bit. Here-- you can take my items.
QuestBaloogyMellow.completedialogue: Thanks again, Rick! I’m settling in for a How Did I Get Here! marathon.

QuestGuardRick.name: Behind Every Lover, There is a Rick
QuestGuardRick.description: Guard Rick wants a companion for the storage Mortys.
QuestGuardRick.activedialogue: Some of these Mortys have been in storage for ages. Their Ricks dropped them off one day, then never showed up again.*They could really do with something to keep them occupied-- a companion of some sort. Maybe you could craft something?
QuestGuardRick.rejectdialogue: I’m not sure about that. There are a lot of small parts they could choke on. There must be something else they can have that will keep them busy.
QuestGuardRick.acceptdialogue: Oh, wow. Look at that craftsmanship! The curves... it’s beautiful...*I’ll get this to the stored Mortys after I’ve run some, uh, safety checks on it first.*Here, take this payment-- just don’t tell the other guards about this, ok?
QuestGuardRick.completedialogue: Please leave me alone, Rick. I have a very rigorous testing process I must conduct.

QuestJerry4.name: The Rick In Me is a Rick In You
QuestJerry4.description: Jerry is wondering what life would be like in a new dimension.
QuestJerry4.activedialogue: You spend so much time in different dimensions, around different versions of yourself, Rick.*I’ve always wondered what life would be like for me in a different dimension. Could you help me find out?
QuestJerry4.rejectdialogue: I’m not sure what insight this gives me into alternate versions of myself, Rick. Can we try something else?
QuestJerry4.acceptdialogue: This is perfect, Rick!*I wonder if there's a dimension where I’m the winner of the Regional Advertiser of the Year award?*I found a box of your stuff labeled "Purified". I was going to throw it out, but you may as well take it.
QuestJerry4.completedialogue: I think I’m going to enjoy this, Rick!

QuestDandyRick2.name: Dude, Where's My Rick?
QuestDandyRick2.description: Dandy Rick's car battery has died.
QuestDandyRick2.activedialogue: Blast! My new Morty is even more of an imbecile than the last!*He left the car radio on overnight and the battery is drained. Can you craft me a battery powerful enough to power my car?
QuestDandyRick2.rejectdialogue: That's not powerful enough to get my flying car off the ground.
QuestDandyRick2.acceptdialogue: That's it, Rick! You really came through for me this time.*No longer must I rely on Mortys for help.*Someone keeps leaving leaflets on my windshield. Here, take one of them for me, will you?
QuestDandyRick2.completedialogue: I have relieved my Mortys from duty. It seems I will need to find new ones for my future battles.

QuestMascotMorty.name: Virtual Rickality
QuestMascotMorty.description: Plush Suit Morty wants to give the other Mortys a distraction from their horrible lives.
QuestMascotMorty.activedialogue: Hey... Psst... Rick! Over here! It's me, Morty!*The council has us working inside these suits, hyping up the crowd so they can keep making money off of this Morty craze!*They have us all chipped and under their control... except for me!*My chip broke, Rick. I'm free, but I can’t just leave my fellow Mortys behind. So, I'll make you a deal.*Craft them something that will keep them entertained and distracted from their horrible lives. In return, I'll join you and your Mortys.*Please help them, Rick. Please!
QuestMascotMorty.rejectdialogue: That's just not cutting it, Rick. They need a distraction, something that lets them live in someone else's shoes in a new life...
QuestMascotMorty.acceptdialogue: Oh, wow, a portable Roy game! The other Mortys can find an escape from their awful lives with this!*I remember when my Rick used to take me to Blips And Chitz. We would spend hours on this...*Rick, you've been so kind. I'll keep my word. I'll join your party!

TournTrainer_2_3_2.name: How Did I Get Here Presenter

DialTourn_1_1_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_1_1_Organiser_1.dialogue: Let’s get you set up for the first round of this event.*It’s forbidden to take your own Mortys and Items into the arena. You’ll pick from our rental Mortys instead. Spend your battle juice wisely…

DialTourn_1_1_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Gene
DialTourn_1_1_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Welcome, fellow Morty trainers!*The recent rise in Morty battling has attracted the attention of an almighty head that floats in the sky above us.*All hail the floating head!*He is comanding us to show him what we have got-- let's not dissapoint him!

DialTourn_1_1_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Cromulon
DialTourn_1_1_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: SHOW ME WHAT YOU GOT!*I WANT TO SEE WHAT YOU GOT!

DialTourn_1_1_1_BattleIntro_3.name: Gene
DialTourn_1_1_1_BattleIntro_3.dialogue: We must put on the best Morty battle the multiverse has ever seen!*Come forth, competitors! Sacrifice your Mortys in the name of entertainment for our glorious visitor!

DialTourn_1_1_1_BattleStart_1.name: Woozlebort
DialTourn_1_1_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Assimilate my lower supportive ectodermal layer, man.

DialTourn_1_1_1_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_1_1_BattleStart_2.dialogue: I'm not entirely sure what's going on here, to be quite honest.*But I do like a good battle. It's time to see what these rent-a-Mortys are made of.

DialTourn_1_1_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: Oooweee! Well, how did you like that folks?*Looks like Gene is trying to impress Cromulon with Morty battles.*Will this Cromulon like what he sees? I sure as hell hope so!

DialTourn_1_1_2_BattleStart_1.name: Glorgan Machio
DialTourn_1_1_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: There’s no Morty pusher in the local cluster as swift and alkaline as Glorgan Machio.

DialTourn_1_1_2_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_1_2_BattleStart_2.dialogue: Wow, it looks like Gene has really scraped the bottom of the multiversal barrel to find these goons.

DialTourn_1_1_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Glorgan Machio
DialTourn_1_1_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: My regurgitative ducts overflow, bloated with the shame of losing to a warm blood.

DialTourn_1_1_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: These strange beings don't seem too bothered by the great Cromulon that's staring down on us.*Let's hope they pick up their game and put on a real show.

DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleStart_1.name: Tazokrak Jones
DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: My gestational surrogate pod said to knock you out, so I’m gonna knock you out.

DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleStart_2.dialogue: Eww, gross. Keep your gestational thoughts to yourself.

DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Tazokrak Jones
DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: They’re never going to allow me back into the hive now! Not after losing to you...

DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleEnd_2.name: Cromulon
DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: HMM.. I NEED TO SEE MORE OF WHAT YOU GOT!

DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleEnd_3.name: Gene
DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleEnd_3.dialogue: It's not working, Rick!*We need to put on more of a show! Who knows what this giant head is capable of?!?

DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleEnd_4.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleEnd_4.dialogue: Gene, you're taking this too seriously. Let's have some fun here!*Get loose and schwifty with it, man!

DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleEnd_5.name: Gene
DialTourn_1_1_3_BattleEnd_5.dialogue: Don't you dare disrespect the head with your filthy dance moves, Rick! The head wants to see Morty battles!*I'm going to find some more contestants. Be sure to come back soon for the next round.

DialTourn_1_2_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_1_2_Organiser_1.dialogue: The Cromulon is still waiting to be impressed.*I suggest you pick some more Mortys and get back out there!

DialTourn_1_2_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Gene
DialTourn_1_2_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Welcome back to the ... er ... greatest Morty battle show in the multiverse!

DialTourn_1_2_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_2_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: You still going ahead with this, Gene?*What makes you think the head in the sky has any interest in this little show of yours?

DialTourn_1_2_1_BattleIntro_3.name: Gene
DialTourn_1_2_1_BattleIntro_3.dialogue: Little show?? How dare you!*The head wants battles, I know it! So battles are what we shall give him.*I've found some new opponents who will put up more of a fight. This'll be a real showdown for our supreme leader in the sky.

DialTourn_1_2_1_BattleStart_1.name: Humox 7
DialTourn_1_2_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: We Humoxies are unable to feel the same emotions as a human. However, battling Mortys gives us an insight into the pain your species revels in.*I wish to demonstrate this emotion of "pain" upon your Mortys.

DialTourn_1_2_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Humox 7
DialTourn_1_2_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Did you see that, Rick? With every hit they scream out with joy. Oh, how they love it.

DialTourn_1_2_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: An intense first battle comes to an end and Rick is victorious! It's unclear yet if this is what the Cromulon wants to see.*Let’s see how Rick does in the next round.

DialTourn_1_2_2_BattleStart_1.name: Humox 10
DialTourn_1_2_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I watch my Mortys battle so that I might experience true emotions.*I want you to make me feel, Rick. Please, show them the cruel truths of this world.

DialTourn_1_2_2_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_2_2_BattleStart_2.dialogue: I've got something to show you right here, you freak!

DialTourn_1_2_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Humox 10
DialTourn_1_2_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Yes, that’s it, Rick. Take in their misery. Feel that sweet sensation wash over you.

DialTourn_1_2_2_BattleEnd_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_2_2_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: Wow, you guys are pretty screwed up. I hope the next Humox is as nuts as you.

DialTourn_1_2_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: Oooweee, in an strange turn of events it seems the Humoxies are enjoying watching their Mortys get dazed.*But will this satisfy the Cromulon?

DialTourn_1_2_3_BattleStart_1.name: Humox 50
DialTourn_1_2_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I hoped you would make it this far, Rick. I look forward to absorbing your pain when I defeat you.*I won't hold back, Rick. I will make you beg to save your Mortys.

DialTourn_1_2_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Humox 50
DialTourn_1_2_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: You have proven you revel in the darkness like us, Rick.*Detach yourself from your feelings and you may yet save this world.

DialTourn_1_2_3_BattleEnd_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_2_3_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: Hey, I'm pitching alternate versions of my grandsons against each other.*I think my feelings are suitability detached right now.

DialTourn_1_2_3_BattleEnd_4.name: Gene
DialTourn_1_2_3_BattleEnd_4.dialogue: Why did I trust those freaks to put on a good show??*Wait! I know which people I should have gotten all along...*Come back soon for the next round, Rick. I'm going to bring some real believers into the mix!

DialTourn_1_2_3_BattleEnd_5.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_2_3_BattleEnd_5.dialogue: I can't even imagine what you have in mind next, Gene.

DialTourn_1_3_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_1_3_Organiser_1.dialogue: It seems Gene has called along his fellow 'believers' in one last attempt at putting on a great show.*I guess you better get in on this, Rick.

DialTourn_1_3_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Cromulon
DialTourn_1_3_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: I NEED TO SEE WHAT YOU GOT.*THIS IS YOUR FINAL CHANCE!

DialTourn_1_3_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Gene
DialTourn_1_3_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: Giant head in the sky, please forgive everything we have done. We will play games no more.*We shall now deliver to you the greatest battles you have ever seen.

DialTourn_1_3_1_BattleStart_1.name: Jerry
DialTourn_1_3_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Woohoo! Giant head in the sky! Floaty-floaty!*Cranial snatcher, so big, so supreme!

DialTourn_1_3_1_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_3_1_BattleStart_2.dialogue: Oh boy, Jerry. You really let them do a number on you.

DialTourn_1_3_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Jerry
DialTourn_1_3_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Twinkle twinkle giant head! Sparkle, sparkle.

DialTourn_1_3_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: Oooweee, Gene has found some real mixed nuts this time.*Can we get that Jerry some medical attention?

DialTourn_1_3_2_BattleStart_1.name: Summer
DialTourn_1_3_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: In my dimension we have learned to live in peace with the heavenly heads.*If there is anyone that can please them, it is I.

DialTourn_1_3_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Summer
DialTourn_1_3_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: It's not working! I did everything you asked, oh great ones.*Why does this not please you?

DialTourn_1_3_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: I'm not sure if it's the week-old pizza in my belly giving me butterflies or the fear of inevitable doom!*Is there anything Gene can do?

DialTourn_1_3_3_BattleStart_1.name: Gene
DialTourn_1_3_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: RICK! We must end this now, no more substitutes!*I have come to the conclusion that the giant head wants to see you pulverized into tiny pieces.*I'm stepping up to the plate to give him the ultimate showdown!

DialTourn_1_3_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Cromulon
DialTourn_1_3_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: YES! I LOVE CHIPTUNE VERSIONS OF THEME TUNES!*I LIKE WHAT YOU GOT, MR PRESIDENT.*YOU WIN THE PLANET MUSIC COMPETITION!

DialTourn_1_3_3_BattleEnd_3.name: Rick
DialTourn_1_3_3_BattleEnd_3.dialogue: Well Gene, as I assumed all along, the Cromulon is not the slightest bit interested in this little show of yours.*You know he can see a lot from up there, right? Like the whole PLANET MUSIC competition happening next door?*Anyway, it was fun pummeling your cronies.

DialTourn_1_3_3_BattleEnd_4.name: Gene
DialTourn_1_3_3_BattleEnd_4.dialogue: Oh dear. I ... uhh ... think I'll be going now. Take this... and don't speak a word of this to the other believers!

DialTourn_2_1_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_2_1_Organiser_1.dialogue: Hey, Rick. Michael and Pichael Thompson have the arena packed out for some sort of charity event.*It all looks rather suspicious to me, but hey-- it's for charity, so get in there and fight for the cause!

DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Did you know across the Central Finite Curve right now there are Mortys without a Rick to call his or her own?*Hi, I’m Michael Thompson. We believe no Morty should have to suffer alone...

DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: ...That's why we are dedicated to bringing Mortys together into smaller, easier to manage groups.*Together we can make a difference. Hi, I’m Pichael Thompson.

DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleIntro_3.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleIntro_3.dialogue: At MORTY-THON 14 we hope, with your help, to touch as many Mortys as we can tonight...*LET'S HELP SOME MORTYS!

DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleStart_1.name: Ants In My Eyes Johnson
DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I’m Ants In My Eyes Johnson. Here at Ants In My Eyes Johnson Electronics, we care about the treatment of Mortys, I think... *I cannot tell as there are so many ants in my eyes!

DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Ants In My Eyes Johnson
DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: I’m not sure if I won or lost as there are so many ants in my eyes at this moment... *I’m Ants In My Eyes Johnson, caring about Mortys!

DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleEnd_2.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_1_1_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: Ouch! Just goes to show the shocking treatment that Mortys receive daily.*That's why your support tonight can make all the difference.*Please, dig deep and keep dropping those Schmeckles in the collection boxes.

DialTourn_2_1_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: Oooweee what a battle, oh boy oh my. Looks like Ants In My Eyes Johnson didn't see that one coming.*Can’t wait to see who’s up next...

DialTourn_2_1_2_BattleIntro_1.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_1_2_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: It’s easy to forget sometimes that Mortys are people with rights and feelings, that’s why we want to do something about it.

DialTourn_2_1_2_BattleIntro_2.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_1_2_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: So tonight at MORTY-THON 14 we’ve invited all your favorite TV celebrities to help out. But these A-listers don't come cheap-- so keep donating those Schmeckles!

DialTourn_2_1_2_BattleStart_1.name: Mr. Sneezy
DialTourn_2_1_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Oww, I’m Mr Sneezy ... -achoo-*Here to help raise awareness about the terrible ... -achoo- ... things that can happen to a Morty late at night. LET’S BATTLE!

DialTourn_2_1_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Mr. Sneezy
DialTourn_2_1_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: You really ... -achoo- ... blew out Mr Sneezy on that one.

DialTourn_2_1_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: Ooowee! What a crazy character! What did you think of that battle, hmmmm? Should have taken it sneezy, by the looks of it. *He’ll nose better next time, oh boy oh boy!

DialTourn_2_1_3_BattleIntro_1.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_1_3_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Up next, an important message just for you...

DialTourn_2_1_3_BattleStart_1.name: Lil' Bits
DialTourn_2_1_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Each year, over 3 Mortys will be neglected and possibly even abandoned by their Ricks.*Those little M's should have come over to Lil' Bits-- we’ve got you covered!

DialTourn_2_1_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Lil' Bits
DialTourn_2_1_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Looks like you beat me you dumb piece of...*Haha, just kidding. Remember, if your mouth’s tiny and small come on over to Lil’ Bits. We’ve got you covered.

DialTourn_2_2_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_2_2_Organiser_1.dialogue: MORTY-THON 14 is in full swing, you'd better get back in there...

DialTourn_2_2_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_2_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Welcome back! Tonight’s MORTY-THON 14 is brought to you by TURBULENT JUICE.*It’s coming and you’ve got to take care of it.

DialTourn_2_2_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Turbulent Juice Morty
DialTourn_2_2_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: Ahh, I’m TURBULENT JUICE MORTY a-and I support this message.

DialTourn_2_2_1_BattleStart_1.name: Trunk Person
DialTourn_2_2_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Hi, I’m a Trunk Person. I know what Denny and The Denny Singers would do if they could get their hands on a helpless Morty.*As a trunk person I’m not about to let that happen... are you?

DialTourn_2_2_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Trunk Person
DialTourn_2_2_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Well, I hope my public defeat has raised some Schmeckles for the poor homeless Mortys out there.

DialTourn_2_2_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: Ooowee, haha. Oh boy, did you see that guy's face? It made me feel sick. Haha, I’m just kidding! *Wouldn’t that be crazy? I’m all for trunk people.

DialTourn_2_2_2_BattleIntro_1.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_2_2_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Powerful stuff on display here tonight. Makes you feel. Makes you think.

DialTourn_2_2_2_BattleIntro_2.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_2_2_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: Well, don't think about it too much, Michael, because next up we have the REAL Mrs. Sullivan with more heartfelt words about Mortys.

DialTourn_2_2_2_BattleStart_1.name: Mrs. Sullivan
DialTourn_2_2_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Why hello there young man, I’m dying to tell you all about my upcoming movie. *Between you, me and Puss-puss here it’s the only reason I care about Mortys right now.

DialTourn_2_2_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Mrs. Sullivan
DialTourn_2_2_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Shoot, you got me good.*I'd just like to mention that my latest movie - Last Will & Testimeow: Weekend at Dead Cat Lady's House II, is in theaters across selected dimensions this summer.

DialTourn_2_2_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: Ooowee, haha. What a show, boy oh boy. Did you see that cat, it looked right at me! *Let's keep watching to see what’s going to happen next. Rick’s really coming out on top tonight, oooweee.

DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleIntro_1.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Every three seconds, a Morty somewhere is lost to the chaos and indifference of the universe...

DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleIntro_2.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: ...our next guest knows more than most about the cruelty a Morty can face. Last year he famously rescued a Morty from under a truck!

DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleStart_1.name: Michael Jenkins
DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I’m Michael Jenkins, here to fill all you TWERPS in ‘bouts the bad things that's been a-happening to those MORTYS, ya hear? It ain’t right.

DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Michael Jenkins
DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Can’t believe a beanpole like you and a bunch of WIMPS beat the JENKINS. Fair play, old man.

DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleEnd_2.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: Emotional stuff... There's a lot of love coming out here tonight. *Remember, there are Mortys out there right now suffering in unbelievable torment.

DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleEnd_3.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_2_3_BattleEnd_3.dialogue: And we at MORTY-THON 14, with your support, will always be there, looking on.*Well, it looks like it's time for us to take another break, but don’t you go nowhere.*We have lots more coming up in part three...

DialTourn_2_3_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_2_3_Organiser_1.dialogue: Get in there, Rick, and help out those Mortys! You hypocrite.

DialTourn_2_3_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Welcome back to MORTY-THON 14! *It’s often said that Mortys are born just to suffer repeatedly across the multiverse, time and time again, serving no real purpose... *Just one big cosmic joke.

DialTourn_2_3_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: Haha, yeah, I know what you mean, Michael!*Anyway, our next guest needs no introduction if you’re a fan of ‘them eyeholes’. I can’t speak for you Michael, but I know I am.

DialTourn_2_3_1_BattleStart_1.name: The Eyehole Man
DialTourn_2_3_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: They asked me to help promote awareness of the daily suffering of Mortys.*But I don’t care about that, I just want my eyeholes!*I’m The Eyehole Man, I’m the only one allowed to have eye holes around here.

DialTourn_2_3_1_BattleEnd_1.name: The Eyehole Man
DialTourn_2_3_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: You beat The Eyehole Man, you better not be looking in my eyeholes.*Get up on out of here with my eyeholes.

DialTourn_2_3_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: Haha, ooowee. What a rush! I sure would like some of those eye holes, I just want to push my fingers deep inside.*Please excuse me, I'm feeling dizzy from all the fun on offer here tonight. Oh boy oh boy!

DialTourn_2_3_2_BattleIntro_1.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_2_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Now, let's take a moment here at MORTY-THON 14 to step back and look at the real message of the night... *You are a bad person and you hate Mortys. in all probability, you want them to suffer.

DialTourn_2_3_2_BattleIntro_2.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_2_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: You're not wrong, Michael, but somewhere right now a Morty is hiding in fear and we need the funds to go and find him.*Let’s reach out together, keep the donations coming!

DialTourn_2_3_2_BattleStart_1.name: How Did I Get Here Presenter
DialTourn_2_3_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Hi, you may recognize me from the popular show ‘How Did I Get Here?’ but tonight I’ll be asking, how did I get these MORTYS?

DialTourn_2_3_2_BattleStart_2.name: Shell Shocked Morty
DialTourn_2_3_2_BattleStart_2.dialogue: Wait, how did I get here?

DialTourn_2_3_2_BattleEnd_1.name: How Did I Get Here Presenter
DialTourn_2_3_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Whoa, easy there, tiger. Looks like you beat me tonight. Hoping to see you again real soon...

DialTourn_2_3_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: Ooowee, the excitement is overflowing and the air is thick with the smell of pleasure. How DID he get those MORTYS? *What do you think will happen next? My arms are numb, oh my!

DialTourn_2_3_3_BattleIntro_1.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_3_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Up next with an important message is everyone's favorite long-armed, office-supply-poaching little kleptomaniac FREAK.

DialTourn_2_3_3_BattleIntro_2.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_3_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: That's right Michael, watch your pockets out there folks!

DialTourn_2_3_3_BattleStart_1.name: Mr. Stealy
DialTourn_2_3_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Hey, I’m Stealy. I'm here to talk to you about those Mortys. *Did you know that, each year, 10 million hundred Mortys go missing about the place? Here’s some I ... found.

DialTourn_2_3_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Mr. Stealy
DialTourn_2_3_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Wow, what an adventure we just had there. Looks like Stealy came out last though.*Back to the quiet safe room to work over my Mortys some more.

DialTourn_2_3_3_Announcer_1.dialogue: Boy oh boy, I missed all of that. I had a package being delivered back at my place, something I ordered online. *I got a call from my neighbor telling me it had arrived so I went home. It was left right outside my door, oooowee!

DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleIntro_1.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Well, it’s been a wild roller coaster thrill ride of awareness and social responsibility.*Rest assured that all the money raised here tonight will be resting in our personal bank accounts until all the Mortys are at peace. *We'd like to thank you all for coming and-

DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleIntro_2.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: ... wait, Michael-- it’s not over yet! Who’s this slippery customer? Hahahaha...

DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleStart_1.name: Octopus Man
DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I’m Octopus Man, hahaha. I’m a marine biologist who was bitten by an octopus. Now I'm here to help people, uh, here tonight.*I’ve gotta save some trouble with the Mortys.

DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_1.name: Octopus Man
DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Haha, I’m a troublesome octopus person and it looks like I lost tonight. Too many witnesses for the trouble-mite to help out Octopus Man this time.

DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_2.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: Well Rick, thanks for playing along tonight! We’ve had highs and we’ve had lows.*Let’s never forget that for every Morty in here there’s a family without a son.

DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_3.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_3.dialogue: Haha, that's right, Michael!*And Rick, do you really think these Mortys remember nothing of their previous lives? Are the manipulator chips really that powerful???

DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_4.name: Michael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_4.dialogue: Rick, at the end of the day this is all your doing.*Everything.

DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_5.name: Pichael Thompson
DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_5.dialogue: So, until next time, sleep safe and a goodnight to all!

DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_6.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_2_3_4_BattleEnd_6.dialogue: Thanks for your participation in MORTY-THON 14. Here’s your prize. Don’t choke on it, big shot.

DialTourn_3_1_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_3_1_Organiser_1.dialogue: It looks like some Jerrys have banded together in an attempt to get recognized.*Do us all a favor and put them in their place, Rick.

DialTourn_3_1_1_BattleIntro_1.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Ricks! We welcome you here tonight to witness history in the making!*For too long, the greatness of Jerrys has gone unnoticed.*For too long, Jerrys have been pushed to the side and ignored.*Well, not any more. Tonight we make our stand and show that we, too, can be legendary Morty trainers.

DialTourn_3_1_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Suit Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: Handsome Jerry is in the ring and ready to take on anyone!*Which lucky contestant would like to be defeated today?

DialTourn_3_1_1_BattleStart_1.name: Handsome Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I make my Mortys eat a whole chicken before every battle!*It gives them the protein they need to stay strong.

DialTourn_3_1_1_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_3_1_1_BattleStart_2.dialogue: That's great, Jerry... That's just real great.

DialTourn_3_1_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Handsome Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: You might have beaten me, Rick, but you won't break the bond between us Jerrys!

DialTourn_3_1_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: It looks like Jerrys across the multiverse have banded together in a show of strength!*Another Jerry is entering the ring, let's see how Rick handles him.

DialTourn_3_1_2_BattleIntro_1.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_2_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: So what-- you won a single battle, Rick? Your next opponent means business. Don't think crossing him will be so easy.

DialTourn_3_1_2_BattleStart_1.name: Suit Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Your request to win this battle is about to be denied, Rick!

DialTourn_3_1_2_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_3_1_2_BattleStart_2.dialogue: Denied? Whatever you say, Jerry. You're certainly the expert on denial around here.

DialTourn_3_1_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Suit Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Oh no, not like this! I hope Beth isn't watching...

DialTourn_3_1_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: The Jerrys are digging their feet in and battling hard!*Will they be able to prove themselves against Rick?

DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleIntro_1.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Order!! I will not allow the name 'Jerry' to be tarnished like this!

DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleIntro_2.name: Suit Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: Sorry boss, my lucky socks were in the wash.

DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleIntro_3.name: Handsome Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleIntro_3.dialogue: My Mortys must have been slacking in their training. I'm switching them to whole grain bread from now on!

DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleStart_1.name: Underwear Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Time to show you who really wears the pants around here!

DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleStart_2.dialogue: Oh God, Jerry. Put it away, you're not impressing anyone with that.

DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Underwear Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: I'm not going to lie. That cooould have gone better.

DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleEnd_2.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_1_3_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: You might have won this round, Rick, but I will be back with more brothers.*Jerrys will be recognized!

DialTourn_3_2_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_3_2_Organiser_1.dialogue: King Jerry is back with new Jerrys for you to challange.*I'm going to enjoy watching you put him down again.

DialTourn_3_2_1_BattleIntro_1.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Welcome back, Rick. I've found plenty more Jerrys to join my cause.*Together we will prove to you that we are worthy of resepect and gratitude.

DialTourn_3_2_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Super Morty Fan Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: When I heard what King Jerry was doing, I had to come see my sweet Mortys in action.

DialTourn_3_2_1_BattleIntro_3.name: No Good Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_1_BattleIntro_3.dialogue: Let me at him and I'll make sure no one hears from him again.

DialTourn_3_2_1_BattleStart_1.name: Self-Promoting Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I'm Jerry Smith and this battle will be just another drop in my ocean of greatness.

DialTourn_3_2_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Self-Promoting Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: A loss is just an opportunity to learn and get better. I'm glad this was the outcome!

DialTourn_3_2_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: That Jerry seemed too confident for my liking. They won't be winning anything if they keep that up.

DialTourn_3_2_2_BattleIntro_1.name: Self-Promoting Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_2_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: King Jerry, you are a great guy and I believe that we've GOT this! We have GOT it!

DialTourn_3_2_2_BattleIntro_2.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_2_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: Ugh, why did I even think you had a chance? I'm sending out a Jerry who will end this.

DialTourn_3_2_2_BattleStart_1.name: No Good Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: You think you can take a stab at me? I'm not a pushover like the other Jerrys.

DialTourn_3_2_2_BattleEnd_1.name: No Good Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: You'll regret you ever crossed me, Rick!

DialTourn_3_2_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: King Jerry seems to be facing some unrest in his ranks. Let's see if he can keep his Jerrys under control.

DialTourn_3_2_3_BattleIntro_1.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_3_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: No no no! I will not be shown up again.*No one loves Mortys more than this guy, Rick. Good luck.

DialTourn_3_2_3_BattleStart_1.name: Super Morty Fan Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I've been studying Mortys ever since I caught my first one. I know everything about them, there's simply no way I'll lose.

DialTourn_3_2_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Super Morty Fan Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: But, my Mortys love me! H-h-how can it end like this??

DialTourn_3_2_3_BattleEnd_2.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_2_3_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: Rick!! I will have my vengeance!

DialTourn_3_3_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_3_3_Organiser_1.dialogue: King Jerry still hasn't learned his lesson. Beat him and his followers once and for all to put an end to this farce.

DialTourn_3_3_1_BattleIntro_1.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_3_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: More Jerrys! Bet you didn't see that one coming, Rick.

DialTourn_3_3_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Paul Fleischman
DialTourn_3_3_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: Hey, eh, I'm not technically a Jerry...

DialTourn_3_3_1_BattleStart_1.name: Mascot Jerry
DialTourn_3_3_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I'm here to motivate the Jerrys back to the top! After they see our battle, people will have no doubt that Jerrys are the greatest.

DialTourn_3_3_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Mascot Jerry
DialTourn_3_3_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Give me a J! Give me a E! Give me... wait, that's it? That's what a Morty battle is? Well, I'm out.

DialTourn_3_3_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: It's all falling apart for the Jerrys. Will King Jerry be dethroned?

DialTourn_3_3_2_BattleIntro_1.name: Mascot Jerry
DialTourn_3_3_2_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: I'll be honest, I'm not even sure what a Morty is.

DialTourn_3_3_2_BattleIntro_2.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_3_2_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: Then why did you sign up?! Why is everyone so incapable of doing ANYthing!?

DialTourn_3_3_2_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_3_3_2_BattleStart_2.dialogue: Really? An inflatable punching bag? You're not even trying anymore, Jerry.

DialTourn_3_3_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: Jerry is really grasping at straws now. He has one follower left and he isn't even a Jerry.

DialTourn_3_3_3_BattleStart_1.name: Paul Fleischman
DialTourn_3_3_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: When I win, I'm taking the crown! Paul Fleischman and his band of Pauls will rule on!

DialTourn_3_3_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Paul Fleischman
DialTourn_3_3_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: I take no responsibility for this. It was all Jerry. Yes, blame Jerry!

DialTourn_3_3_3_Announcer_1.dialogue: King Jerry is making his way to the ring.*It looks like he's getting ready to battle!

DialTourn_3_3_4_BattleStart_1.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_3_4_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I don't need those other Jerrys! I can take you down myself.*Long live the King!

DialTourn_3_3_4_BattleEnd_1.name: King Jerry
DialTourn_3_3_4_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: I... I just wanted to show the world that Jerrys aren't worthless...

DialTourn_3_3_4_BattleEnd_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_3_3_4_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: I know, Jerry. But we can't change who we are. Let's get you back to your Beth.

DialTourn_4_1_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_4_1_Organiser_1.dialogue: Snowball and his dog army are putting on a show!*They want to see if you can hold your own against all their best Mortys.*For the first event, they've brought their favourite pets...

DialTourn_4_1_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Snowball
DialTourn_4_1_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Welcome, Rick. So you want to compete in our Morty Pageant?*Our pet Mortys are the best in show and we are here to demonstrate this to you.

DialTourn_4_1_1_BattleStart_1.name: Rex
DialTourn_4_1_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I'm a domestic Morty breeder. I've chosen only the best pedigrees to show today.*Let's see how good you really are.

DialTourn_4_1_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Rex
DialTourn_4_1_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Your Mortys are like wild animals, Rick!*Sit, Morty. Sit.

DialTourn_4_1_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: Oooweee! There's some cute Mortys in the arena today.*Snowball and his fellow doggy friends are putting on a fine display.

DialTourn_4_1_2_BattleStart_1.name: Butch
DialTourn_4_1_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I see Rex tried to pass off some of his shoddy Mortys.*What you want is a breeder who trains Mortys to win, Rick!

DialTourn_4_1_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Butch
DialTourn_4_1_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: They might be a little scary to look at, but they still need love, Rick.*Not every Morty is a looker.

DialTourn_4_1_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: Scary stuff there, folks. I don't think those Mortys are going to be winning a Morty pageant any time soon!

DialTourn_4_1_3_BattleStart_1.name: Rocky
DialTourn_4_1_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I carry only the finest of Morty wares.*These unique looking Mortys will surely throw you off your game, Rick.

DialTourn_4_1_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Rocky
DialTourn_4_1_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: You had better not damage them, Rick.*They are worth more than you can afford!

DialTourn_4_1_3_BattleEnd_2.name: Snowball
DialTourn_4_1_3_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: A fine showing, Rick. But don't think you can take the trophy that easily.*We have more events to sink our claws into!

DialTourn_4_2_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_4_2_Organiser_1.dialogue: Snowball has given up on pet Mortys and is turning his attention to the upper class of Morty superiority.*I hope you pick Mortys as stylish as his.

DialTourn_4_2_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Snowball
DialTourn_4_2_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: It's time to leave our pets at home and bring out the competition-grade Mortys.*These groomed Mortys have the smoothest coats and the finest attire.*Let's see you try to match them in battle, Rick!

DialTourn_4_2_1_BattleStart_1.name: Rex
DialTourn_4_2_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Oh, right. We were supposed to shower and wash our Mortys...*I might have slacked a little in the upkeep of these Mortys.

DialTourn_4_2_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Rex
DialTourn_4_2_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Mortys are just too cute! I can't tell them what to do.

DialTourn_4_2_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: What a mess!*I can't even remember the last time I had a bath, but those were some dirty Mortys!

DialTourn_4_2_2_BattleStart_1.name: Butch
DialTourn_4_2_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: My Mortys have been shaved and trimmed to competition standards.*Good luck matching their prowess in battle.

DialTourn_4_2_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: Looks like Butch got butchered in that battle!*I'd like to thank Darren in the writing department for coming up with that clever pun.

DialTourn_4_2_3_BattleStart_1.name: Rocky
DialTourn_4_2_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I love a Morty in uniform.*So handsome and charming.

DialTourn_4_2_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Rocky
DialTourn_4_2_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Great, now I need to take all their uniforms to the cleaners.

DialTourn_4_2_3_BattleEnd_2.name: Snowball
DialTourn_4_2_3_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: One more event left, Rick! Next time you won't be so lucky.

DialTourn_4_3_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_4_3_Organiser_1.dialogue: Snowball wants to have some playtime with his Mortys.*Enjoy another event full of interspecies weirdness!

DialTourn_4_3_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Snowball
DialTourn_4_3_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Dogs are not 'all work and no play' like you humans.*That's why our final event will be a display of the best Mortys in fancy dress.*Can your Mortys play their role in society like ours can, Rick? I doubt it.

DialTourn_4_3_1_BattleStart_1.name: Rex
DialTourn_4_3_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: My Mortys made all their own costumes. Don't be too hard on them, Rick!

DialTourn_4_3_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Rex
DialTourn_4_3_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Nothing like a bit of fantasy role playing among a dog and his Mortys.

DialTourn_4_3_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: Oooweee, this pageant sure is getting a whole bundle of strange!*These Mortys sure do look adorable when they're all dressed up, though.

DialTourn_4_3_2_BattleStart_1.name: Butch
DialTourn_4_3_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Hey, Rick. I'll be honest, I'm a big fan of this game.*My Mortys just wanted to show how much they appreciate the effort you've put in.

DialTourn_4_3_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Butch
DialTourn_4_3_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: I'll be sure to leave a 5 star review, Rick.*That's a nice thing that cool people do when they enjoy a mobile game.*Am I being clear enough? Is this carrying well?

DialTourn_4_3_2_Announcer_1.dialogue: Oooweee, I hope everyone's having a good time.*Rick looks to be enjoying himself. Hope he doesn't get carried away and lose it in the last battle.

DialTourn_4_3_3_BattleStart_1.name: Rocky
DialTourn_4_3_3_BattleStart_1.dialogue: My Mortys are all based on 80's action movies!*If they can't beat you, no Morty can!

DialTourn_4_3_3_BattleEnd_1.name: Rocky
DialTourn_4_3_3_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: They don't make Mortys like they used too. I guess there's a reason for that.

DialTourn_4_3_3_BattleEnd_2.name: Snowball
DialTourn_4_3_3_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: You have proven yourself amongst us dogs, Rick.*You have earned this trophy. I crown you winner of the Morty Pageant.

DialTourn_5_1_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_5_1_Organiser_1.dialogue: There’s a weedy looking guy in there looking for a fight. He kind of reminds me of someone...

DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Ah, Mr. Sanchez. We’ve been EXPECTING you. Allow me to welcome you to my little game.*Tonight, the WHOLE world is going to get to see who you REALLY are, Rick.

DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: I’m flattered, but I don’t go for the pencil neck stage magician type... so cut the yap and make your move.

DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleIntro_3.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleIntro_3.dialogue: Haha! Oh, Rick. Have you met my seven friends? I’m sure they will tickle your fancy...

DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleIntro_4.name: Rick
DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleIntro_4.dialogue: Okay, Snow White, these better not be personifications of the seven deadly sins.*Y'know, each one looking like a twisted version of me? That would be pretty lazy.

DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleStart_1.name: Pride Rick
DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I hope this isn’t going to hurt your ‘pride’ Rick.*How is it that you can look just like me yet not be as beautiful? A shame.*Well, let's see how we compare in the Morty department...

DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Pride Rick
DialTourn_5_1_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: I couldn’t have lost, it’s impossible! I must have won somehow...

DialTourn_5_1_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: Oooweee, my oh my. Boy, looks like Rick is up against it now. What a crazy predicament!*Let's keep watching to see how this is going to play out.

DialTourn_5_1_2_BattleIntro_1.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_1_2_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Ah, I see I have PRICKED your interest! Perhaps my next friend will satisfy the LUST in you...

DialTourn_5_1_2_BattleStart_1.name: Lust Rick
DialTourn_5_1_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: Oooh Ricky, I can feel your LUST to be on top, but you’re going to have to come at me HARD if you’re gonna get ahead in this game.

DialTourn_5_1_2_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_5_1_2_BattleStart_2.dialogue: So we're really doing this? I mean, ‘Lust Rick’?

DialTourn_5_1_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Lust Rick
DialTourn_5_1_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Looks like you finished me off. You BEAT me Ricky, beat me good. Oooh.

DialTourn_5_1_2_BattleEnd_2.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_1_2_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: This is only the start of it, Rick. There are a lot more coming up, if you think you can handle it.

DialTourn_5_2_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_5_2_Organiser_1.dialogue: Better get back in there, Rick. That guy's making my skin crawl.

DialTourn_5_2_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_2_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: Ah, you're back, I see*Well, LOOK ON AND BEHOLD, in all its TERRIBLE TRUTH, the ravages of SLOTH!

DialTourn_5_2_1_BattleIntro_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_5_2_1_BattleIntro_2.dialogue: The ravages of SLOTH? Not really striking much fear in me, there.*I was expecting a lot better from you, to tell the truth. Try not to get grease on me.

DialTourn_5_2_1_BattleStart_1.name: Sloth Rick
DialTourn_5_2_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I’m, like, Sloth Rick and stuff. Get ready to whatever...

DialTourn_5_2_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Sloth Rick
DialTourn_5_2_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: Are we done? I’m going to, like, lay down and stuff.

DialTourn_5_2_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: Boy oh my. That Rick sure was lazy. Did you see how lazy he looked?*What a funny situation to be in! I can't wait to see what's going to happen next! Oooweee!

DialTourn_5_2_2_BattleIntro_1.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_2_2_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: I’m not finished with you just yet, Rick. Did no one ever tell you to be careful what you wish for...?

DialTourn_5_2_2_BattleStart_1.name: Wrath Rick
DialTourn_5_2_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: AGHHH, IM GOING TO BREAK YOU, RICK. I’M GOING TO RIP YOU APART.*THEY’RE GOING TO HAVE TO SEND A FORENSIC TEAM BACK TO NEXT WEEK TO IDENTIFY THE STAIN I’M ABOUT TO MAKE OF YOU AND YOUR MORTYS!*THERE’S GONNA BE NOTHING LEFT OF YOU WHEN I’M THROUGH!!

DialTourn_5_2_2_BattleEnd_2.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_2_2_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: You'd better come back for more, Rick. You really don’t want me to have to come and find you...

DialTourn_5_3_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_5_3_Organiser_1.dialogue: The management would like to apologize for the Sulphur smell.

DialTourn_5_3_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_3_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: You grace us with your presence once again, Rick, but no more playing around...

DialTourn_5_3_1_BattleStart_1.name: Envy Rick
DialTourn_5_3_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: A-All that is yours shall be mine Rick! MINE alone. I want it, give it to me!*Nothing can stop the biting rage of envy!

DialTourn_5_3_1_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_5_3_1_BattleStart_2.dialogue: You're asking for it, me! Don’t eat your heart out.

DialTourn_5_3_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Envy Rick
DialTourn_5_3_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: All is lost... do not pity me, let me rest.

DialTourn_5_3_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: Boy. I don’t know if I can handle all this excitement at once ... oooweee! *I think I’m going to have to go sit in a darkened room until my heartbeat returns back to normal, I tell ya!

DialTourn_5_3_2_BattleIntro_1.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_3_2_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: How utterly delightful! Let's see if you have the stomach for another round...

DialTourn_5_3_2_BattleStart_1.name: Gluttony Rick
DialTourn_5_3_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: CONSUME, I SHALL EAT YOU, RICK, AND ALL YOUR MORTYS.*THE FLESH FROM YOUR BONES BETWEEN MY TEETH SHALL TASTE SWEET.

DialTourn_5_3_2_BattleStart_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_5_3_2_BattleStart_2.dialogue: Whatever floats your boat there, buddy.

DialTourn_5_3_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Gluttony Rick
DialTourn_5_3_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: The sickening pain of defeat. Looks like I've bitten off more than I can chew.

DialTourn_5_4_Organiser_1.name: Organizer Rick
DialTourn_5_4_Organiser_1.dialogue: It’s getting pretty hot in there. You'd better finish this.

DialTourn_5_4_1_BattleIntro_1.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_4_1_BattleIntro_1.dialogue: You've returned... but for the final time, Rick. Let us finish this dance.

DialTourn_5_4_1_BattleStart_1.name: Greed Rick
DialTourn_5_4_1_BattleStart_1.dialogue: I WILL WIN. NOTHING SATISFIES ME, YOUR DEMISE WILL NOT QUENCH MY THIRST FOR VICTORY, BUT I WILL TAKE IT NONETHELESS.*YOU HAVE ALREADY LOST.

DialTourn_5_4_1_BattleEnd_1.name: Greed Rick
DialTourn_5_4_1_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: CAN WE JUST, uh, PRETEND I WON?

DialTourn_5_4_1_Announcer_1.dialogue: That Rick from the last event sure was morbidly obese, can’t be healthy for his body! *Boy oh my! It’s not nice to see a Rick let him self go like that. I hope he can get some help.

DialTourn_5_4_2_BattleStart_1.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_4_2_BattleStart_1.dialogue: ENOUGH. FACE ME, RICK! Let us settle this once and for all, the time-honored way...*By having others younger and more impressionable fight on our behalf.

DialTourn_5_4_2_BattleEnd_1.name: Mr. Needful
DialTourn_5_4_2_BattleEnd_1.dialogue: I stand before you, defeated, but you can never REALLY beat me.*I’m always there in the shadows, looking on, waiting for my chance to corup-

DialTourn_5_4_2_BattleEnd_2.name: Rick
DialTourn_5_4_2_BattleEnd_2.dialogue: -Yeah yeah, less talk, more giving me my prize!
